Bevanda bianca e dissetante: mandorle am: A white, thirst-quenching drink: soaked almonds blended with water and strained, lightly sweetened.
Bicchieri a strati di yogurt greco al mi: Layered glasses of Greek yogurt with honey, muesli and freshly cooked blueberry sauce.
Bicchierini a strati di farro soffiato,: Layered glasses of puffed farro, yogurt, peach and chocolate chips, with no cooking.
Bietola, spinaci, lattuga e cavolo cotti: Chard, spinach, lettuce and cabbage cooked, sieved and used to cook rice.
Bignè di pasta cotta al forno, aperti di: Baked choux buns, opened at the side and filled with pastry cream.
Bignè fritti ripieni di crema di ricotta: Fried choux buns filled with ricotta cream, candied peel and pistachio. Soft and creamy, they are eaten fresh on 19 March.
Bignè salati al formaggio con dadini di: Savoury cheese choux with cubes of mortadella, fried until they puff up.
Biscotti da inzuppo cotti due volte, con: Twice-baked dunking biscuits, with rice and chestnut flour instead of wheat, and whole almonds.
Biscotti di Artusi con zucchero di canna: Artusi's biscuits with brown sugar, butter and vanilla, baked in logs and toasted.
Biscotti di Burano a ciambella o a 'S',: Burano biscuits shaped as rings or S shapes, buttery and scented with lemon and vanilla. Crumbly and fragrant, they are dipped in sweet wine.
Biscotti di farina di mais e di grano co: Biscuits of maize and wheat flour with aniseed, butter and lard, glazed with egg.
Biscotti di grano bagnati in aceto e oli: Wheat rusks moistened with vinegar and oil, covered with lettuce and escarole and decorated in segments with anchovies, olives, capers and hard-boiled eggs.
Biscotti di mosto d'uva, miele e mandorl: Biscuits of grape must, honey and almonds, typical of the grape harvest. Dark and hard, they are dipped in wine: they are made at grape-harvest time.
Biscotti fra savoiardo e spumino, fatti: Biscuits halfway between a savoiardo and a spumino, made only of whipped egg yolks and sugar: the sweet institution of San Giovanni in Persiceto.
Biscotti friabili di farina, vino e olio: Crumbly biscuits of flour, wine and oil, perfect for dunking. Crumbly and not very sweet: they are dunked in wine at the end of the meal.
Biscotti gialli di farina di mais con uv: Yellow biscuits of maize flour with raisins, scented with lemon. Crumbly and golden, they are served with sweet wine or coffee.
Biscotti morbidi di farina integrale e f: Soft biscuits of wholemeal flour and oat flakes with grated apple, aniseed and a little sugar.
Biscotti morbidi senza zucchero aggiunto: Soft biscuits with no added sugar: mashed bananas, oat flakes, nut butter, flaxseeds and a little chopped dark chocolate.
Biscotti natalizi di farina, uova, zucch: Christmas biscuits of flour, eggs, sugar, almonds and cinnamon.
Biscotti ovali e friabili all'olio d'oli: Oval, crumbly olive-oil biscuits, typical of the Lomellina. Light and crunchy, dusted with sugar: they are served with tea or coffee.
Biscotti rustici di mandorle e cioccolat: Rustic biscuits of almonds and chocolate, torn by hand. Crisp and irregular, they are served at the end of the meal with wine.
Biscotti secchi alle mandorle tagliati a: Dry almond biscuits cut into slices and baked a second time. Crunchy and hard, they are dipped in Vin Santo at the end of a meal.
Biscotti semplici di farina, burro e lat: Plain biscuits of flour, butter and milk, scored, for dipping in tea.
Biscotti sottilissimi di nocciole e mand: Very thin hazelnut and almond biscuits, curved like roof tiles. Light and crumbly, they are served with tea or at the end of a meal.
Biscotti speziati alla cannella e ai chi: Spiced biscuits with cinnamon and cloves, baked pale and crumbly.
Biscotti speziati di farina, zucchero, c: Spiced biscuits of flour, sugar, cinnamon, cloves, pepper and toasted almonds, kneaded with water and left to rest for a day, then baked and coated in chocolate.
Biscotti tondi di frolla al vino bianco,: Round shortcrust biscuits made with white wine, glazed and sprinkled with walnuts or almonds.
Biscottini sottili di burro, zucchero a: Thin tea biscuits of butter, icing sugar, flour and egg white.
Biscotto di mandorle ripieno di confettu: An almond biscuit filled with cherry or grape jam. Crumbly and a little chewy inside, it is served with coffee.
Biscotto natalizio con frutta secca e sp: A Christmas biscuit with nuts and spices. Crumbly and spiced, they are served at Christmas with sweet wine.
Bistecche cotte adagio con aglio e rosma: Steaks cooked slowly with garlic and rosemary, with the potatoes in the sauce.
Bocconcini di capretto lessati con le er: Morsels of kid boiled with herbs, dipped in egg and breadcrumbs and fried.
Bocconcini di pasta di farina e acqua bo: Morsels of dough made with flour and boiling water, boiled and dressed with butter and cheese.
Bocconcini di pollo con mandorle e salsa: Chicken pieces with almonds and soy sauce, served with a raw salad of radishes, cardoons, carrot and red cabbage.
Bocconcini di pollo cotti lentamente in: Chicken morsels cooked slowly in a pot of sweet onions stewed until they become a sauce.
Bocconcini di pollo passati in pangratta: Chicken pieces coated in breadcrumbs, thyme, sage and rosemary and baked in the oven, with lemon.
Bocconcini di pollo rosolati con cipolla: Chicken pieces browned with onion and rosemary and cooked with tomato, green olives and pine nuts.
Bocconcini di salmone cotti in un sugo d: Morsels of salmon cooked in a sauce of tomato, onion and peas, scented with basil and parsley.
Bocconcini di vitellone rosolati in cass: Small pieces of young beef browned in a casserole with oil, garlic and bay, the Genoese way.
Bocconi di lombo di maiale allo spiedo,: Chunks of pork loin on the spit, alternating with crostini and sage, basted with oil.
Bollire acqua e zucchero, unire papavero: Boil water and sugar, add poppy, honey, lemon and cinnamon and cook the filling.
Bollito misto servito con la pearà, sals: Mixed boiled meats served with pearà, a sauce of bread, bone marrow, broth and plenty of pepper. Pearà is thick and peppery: it is served hot beside the boiled meats.
Borlotti con soffritto d'aglio, salvia e: Borlotti beans with a soffritto of garlic, sage and dried mushrooms, lettuces and cardoon hearts.
Borlotti lessati con cipolla rossa passa: Boiled borlotti beans with red onion steeped in vinegar and a sauce of anchovies, garlic and thyme.
Braciola di manzo cotta nel burro e bagn: Beef chop cooked in butter and moistened with water, with chopped parsley.
Braciole di maiale col loro grasso cotte: Pork chops with their fat cooked slowly for an hour, moistened with white wine.
Braciole di maiale cotte adagio in strut: Pork chops cooked slowly in lard and butter with slices of polenta.
Braciole di maiale cotte un'ora e mezza: Pork chops cooked for an hour and a half with butter, celery, leeks, carrots and potatoes.
Braciole di maiale fiorentine col vino r: Florentine pork chops with red wine, served on top of cavolo nero.
Braciole di maiale marinate in olio e pr: Pork chops marinated in oil and parsley and cooked on the grill.
Bracioline di vitello ripiene di fegatin: Veal bracioline stuffed with chicken livers, anchovies and juniper, wrapped in lard.
Broccoletti ripassati in padella con le: Broccoletti sautéed in the frying pan with the cicure, garlic and chilli.
Broccoli lessati e rosolati nello strutt: Broccoli boiled and browned in strutto with cheese and pepper.
Broccoli romani dal fiore viola cotti cr: Purple-flowered Roman broccoli cooked raw in the frying pan with garlic, oil and white wine.
Brodo bollente versato su pane fritto ne: Boiling broth poured over bread fried in butter, raw egg and grana. The boiling broth just cooks the egg: it is eaten at once, from the bowl.
Brodo di baccalà con aglio, peperoncino: A salt cod broth with garlic, chilli and nepitella poured over toasted bread.
Brodo di cipolla dorata nel burro, legat: A broth of onion browned in butter, bound off the heat with plenty of yolks, on bread.
Brodo di gallina con polpettine, pane fr: Hen broth with little meatballs, fried bread and scamorza, for Christmas and Easter. It is brought to the table in the tureen, gratinated: a festive dish of Molise.
Brodo di gallina con scarola lessata e p: Hen broth with boiled escarole and small meatballs.
Brodo di lische con timo e maggiorana in: A fish-bone broth with thyme and marjoram in which lavaret, roach and trout are cooked.
Brodo di pesce minuto col pomodoro, pass: A broth of small fish with tomato, sieved and poured over eggs and parmesan.
Brodo di pomodori ed erbe cotto a lungo,: A broth of tomatoes and herbs cooked for a long time, sieved, with butter, on toasted bread.
Bruciacchiare la buccia dei marroni in u: Scorch the chestnut skins in a pan with holes just enough to peel them without cooking them; remove the skin and inner skin and wash them.
Bucatini con acciughe, estratto di pomod: Bucatini with anchovies, tomato extract, raisins and pine nuts and toasted muddica.
Budino al cacao e amaretti cotto a bagno: Cocoa and amaretti pudding cooked in a bain-marie with caramel. Soft and dark, with the caramel running down when it is turned out: it is served cold, in slices.
Budino d'anguria con amido, gelsomino, c: A watermelon pudding with starch, jasmine, chocolate and pistachios. Cool and wobbly, it is served cold in summer: it is the Palermo sweet of Ferragosto (15 August).
Budino di latte a strati di savoiardi, u: A milk pudding in layers of savoiardi, raisins, candied fruit and preserves, with kirsch.
Budino di latte e tuorli col croccante d: A pudding of milk and yolks with pounded almond brittle, cooked in a bain-marie.
Budino di latte, cioccolato e mandorle a: A pudding of milk, chocolate and bitter almonds, cooked for an hour in a bain-marie.
Budino di latte, mollica e mandorle pest: A pudding of milk, breadcrumb and pounded almonds, cooked in a bain-marie, with zabaione.
Budino di latte, savoiardi e nocciole pe: A pudding of milk, savoiardi and pounded hazelnuts, cooked in a bain-marie.
Budino di pane, latte, uvetta e liquori: A pudding of bread, milk, raisins and liqueurs in the caramelised mould, served flaming.
Budino di semolino al latte a strati con: A pudding of semolina cooked in milk, in layers with raspberry jam and quince preserve.
Budino di semolino con pistacchi, uvetta: A semolina pudding with pistachios, raisins and candied fruit, soaked with rum.
Budino di semolino con scorza d'arancia,: A semolina pudding with orange zest, amaretti and whisked egg whites, baked in the oven.
Budino di spremuta d'arancia addensata c: A pudding of orange juice thickened with starch, served cold.
Budino freddo di latte e amido con pinol: A cold pudding of milk and starch with pine nuts and vanilla, served with fruit syrup.
Buttare il riso e cuocerlo a fuoco medio: Throw away the rice and cook over medium-low heat, stirring often because it doesn't stick.
Calamaretti e gamberetti infarinati, pas: Small squid and shrimps floured, dipped in egg and fried in oil.
Caldarroste schiacciate con burro e zucc: Roast chestnuts crushed with butter and sugar, flambéed with rum at the table.
Camoscio marinato nel vino rosso con spe: Chamois marinated in red wine with spices and cooked slowly, served with polenta. Dark, tender meat in a spiced sauce: it is served hot with polenta.
Cannellini con soffritto d'odori, pomodo: Cannellini beans with a soffritto of aromatics, tomato and cavolo nero, poured over toasted bread.
Cannellini cotti con cipolla stufata, po: Cannellini beans cooked with stewed onion, tomato, garlic, rosemary and bay.
Cannellini stufati con pomodoro, aglio e: Cannellini beans stewed with tomato, garlic and sage. Soft beans in a light tomato sauce: they are served as a side dish, excellent with sausages.
Cannocchie scottate, coperte di prezzemo: Mantis shrimp blanched, covered with parsley, garlic and breadcrumbs and baked in the oven.
Cappelle di ovoli riempite con i gambi t: Caesar's mushroom caps filled with their chopped stems, garlic and oregano, cooked slowly in oil.
Cappelletti con ripieno di carni miste e: Cappelletti with a filling of mixed meats and cheese, in capon broth. They are served in the hot broth, with parmesan: the festive first course in Pesaro.
Cappello del prete cotto nell'olio con a: Beef «cappello del prete» (priest's hat) cooked in oil with anchovies, served with polenta. Very tender meat in a thick sauce: it is served hot, with polenta.
Cappello del prete di manzo marinato e c: Beef cappello del prete (chuck) marinated and cooked slowly in Barolo. Very tender meat in slices, with its dark, glossy sauce: it is served with polenta or mashed potatoes.
Cappone disossato riempito di filetti, t: A boned capon filled with strips of meat, truffle and pistachios, boiled and pressed.
Cappone farcito di tartufi al burro e ma: Capon stuffed with truffles in butter and marsala, left for a day to absorb the flavour and then roasted.
Cappone fasciato di prosciutto e lessato: A capon wrapped in prosciutto and boiled inside a bladder, served cold.
Cappone lessato chiuso in un tovagliolo: Capon boiled wrapped in a napkin with lemon and bay leaf, served cold in aspic.
Cappone rosolato intero nel burro e fini: Capon browned whole in butter and finished cooking covered, with a splash of broth.
Capretto a pezzi stufato sulle cipolle n: Kid in pieces stewed on onions in lard, with pepper and a pinch of cinnamon.
Capriolo marinato nell'aceto e stufato i: Roe deer marinated in vinegar and stewed sweet and sour with chocolate, pine nuts and raisins.
Caramellare lo zucchero, aggiungere burr: Caramel the sugar, add butter, apples, ginger, lime and cinnamon and cook gently without undoing the fruit.
Carciofi a fette con funghi, aglio e pom: Sliced artichokes with mushrooms, garlic and tomato, in a frittata with breadcrumb and oregano.
Carciofi aperti a fiore, cotti ritti in: Artichokes opened like a flower, cooked upright in the oven with oil, salt and plenty of pepper.
Carciofi appena scottati per aprirne le: Artichokes just scalded to open their leaves, filled with mozzarella and cooked in butter in a covered pan: one of the fillings Cavalcanti suggests for «carcioffi farsiti» (stuffed artichokes).
Carciofi e piselli al sugo di carne con: Artichokes and peas in meat sauce with parmesan, under a shortcrust lid.
Carciofi e piselli stufati nel burro col: Artichokes and peas stewed in butter with a soffritto, bound with yolks and lemon.
Carciofi farciti di vitello, prosciutto: Artichokes stuffed with veal, prosciutto and dried mushrooms, browned and steamed.
Carciofi riempiti di ragù di vitello, av: Artichokes filled with veal ragù, wrapped in minced meat, breaded and fried.
Carciofi romaneschi fritti interi due vo: Roman artichokes fried whole twice until they open like crisp flowers. Golden and crisp as crisps outside, tender at the heart: eat them at once, salted.
Carciofi sbollentati e passati, legati c: Artichokes blanched and sieved, bound with béchamel, eggs and parmesan.
Carciofi stufati con aceto, aglio e orig: Artichokes stewed with vinegar, garlic and oregano, bound with an anchovy sauce.
Carciofi teneri interi conditi con olio,: Whole tender artichokes dressed with oil, salt and pepper and cooked upright on the grill.
Carciofini lessati, rosolati nello strut: Small artichokes boiled, browned in lard and sprinkled with cheese, served piping hot.
Cardi a pezzetti rosolati nel burro e le: Cardoons in small pieces browned in butter and bound with béchamel, eggs and parmesan.
Cardi lessati e fritti in una pastella a: Cardoons boiled and fried in an egg batter with spring onion and anchovy.
Cardi lessati e gratinati in tegame con: Cardoons boiled and baked in a dish with butter, Parmigiano and sausage.
Cardi lessati e tritati con funghi, pres: Boiled, chopped cardoons with mushrooms, prescinseua, Parmigiano and eggs, baked in the oven.
Cardi lessati, infarinati e finiti di cu: Cardoons boiled, floured and finished slowly in butter until they brown.
Cardi lessati, passati nel burro e fritt: Cardoons boiled, tossed in butter and fried in batter with whisked egg white.
Cardoni lessati e stufati con aglio e pr: Cardoons boiled and stewed with garlic and parsley, under an egg and lemon sauce.
Cardoni lessati, infarinati e rosolati n: Cardoons boiled, floured and browned in oil, then bound with beaten eggs.
Carne di castrato o manzo stufata con ag: Mutton or beef stewed with garlic and rosemary, potatoes and tomato sauce.
Carne di cavallo marinata e stufata a lu: Horse meat marinated and stewed for a long time in red wine, served with polenta. Dark, tender meat in a thick sauce: it is served hot with polenta.
Carne di maiale cotta al forno ricoperta: Pork baked in the oven coated with sweet and hot chilli, with vinegar. Red and hot, it is eaten hot or cold, also in a sandwich.
Carne di manzo tritata, spianata col mat: Minced beef, rolled out with the rolling pin, cooked in butter and tomato.
Carne e verdure cotte 3 ore nella stessa: Meat and vegetables cooked for 3 hours in the same pot, served with the broth over bread.
Carne salata di maiale lessata e finita: Salted pork boiled and finished cooking in white cabbage.
Carote lessate e passate nel burro, prof: Carrots boiled and tossed in butter, scented with cinnamon and lemon.
Carote lessate, condite con olio e grati: Carrots boiled, dressed with oil and baked in the oven with Parmigiano and oregano.
Casarecce integrali saltate con champign: Wholemeal casarecce tossed with button mushrooms with garlic and chilli and bound with a white bean cream.
Castagne fresche pelate e lessate col fi: Fresh chestnuts peeled and boiled with fennel, to be eaten as they are or in milk.
Castagne lessate e mele saltate, con ara: Boiled chestnuts and sautéed apples, with oranges, mandarins, walnuts and chocolate shavings, covered with warm crème anglaise.
Castagne, ceci e noci lessati e pestati: Chestnuts, chickpeas and walnuts boiled and pounded with sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg, bound with yolks and fried as fritters: an autumn sweet to serve hot with sugar.
Castagne, scalogni e funghi in padella c: Chestnuts, shallots and mushrooms in a pan with rosemary, white wine and cabbage.
Castrato a dadini a strati con lardo, ci: Diced mutton in layers with lard, onions and potatoes, cooked with plenty of paprika.
Castrato a pezzi grossi stufato sul soff: Large pieces of mutton stewed on a soffritto of aromatic vegetables, cinnamon and tomato.
Castrato a pezzi stufato nel burro con a: Mutton in pieces stewed in butter with pounded garlic and rosemary, wine and tomatoes.
Cavatelli di semola con broccoli, aglio,: Semolina cavatelli with broccoli, garlic, chilli and toasted breadcrumbs. A simple, savoury dish: it is served hot, with the crisp breadcrumbs on top.
Cavatelli di semola con sugo di pomodoro: Semolina cavatelli with tomato sauce and hot ventricina. A red, hot sauce: it is served at once, hot.
Cavatelli di semola conditi con mollica: Semolina cavatelli dressed with breadcrumbs fried in oil with garlic and crumbled peperone crusco.
Cavatelli di semola cotti con le cimette: Semolina cavatelli cooked with broccoli florets and dressed with oil, garlic, chilli and pecorino.
Cavolfiore lessato e tritato nel burro,: Boiled cauliflower chopped in butter, in a thin parmesan omelette.
Cavolfiore rosolato nel burro e cotto ne: Cauliflower browned in butter and cooked in milk, bound with béchamel and eggs.
Cavoli rapa giovani a fettine rosolati n: Young kohlrabi in thin slices browned in butter and then stewed.
Cavoli, lattuga, erbe, patate, fagioli e: Cabbage, lettuce, herbs, potatoes, beans and peas in broth, finished with rice.
Cavolo bianco a filetti scottato, tenuto: White cabbage in thin strips, scalded, kept in vinegar and stewed with prosciutto.
Cavolo cappuccio a filetti cotto con sal: White cabbage in fine strips cooked with salt, vinegar, oil and garlic, for boiled meats and chicken.
Cavolo cappuccio a listarelle arrostito: White cabbage in strips roasted with oil and onion, then stewed for an hour and a half.
Cavolo cappuccio rosso crudo tagliato fi: Raw red cabbage finely shredded, with hazelnuts and diced primosale, oil and balsamic vinegar.
Cavolo intero farcito di vitello, fegati: A whole cabbage stuffed with veal, chicken livers and béchamel, cooked in the juices of the stracotto.
Cavolo nero lessato e ripassato in padel: Cavolo nero boiled and tossed in the pan with garlic and broth, with sausages.
Cavolo nero lessato e tritato, insaporit: Cavolo nero boiled and chopped, flavoured in butter with prosciutto and onion.
Cavolo soffritto nel lardo e cotto due o: Cabbage fried in lard and cooked for two hours with salted meat, then thinned with broth.
Ceci con tonno al naturale, pomodori, ci: Chickpeas with tuna in water, tomatoes, red onion steeped in vinegar and green salad.
Ceci e borlotti con asparagi cotti in pa: Chickpeas and borlotti beans with pan-cooked asparagus, tuna in brine, olives and pickles, dressed with lemon and oregano.
Ceci lessati e conditi con olio e limone: Boiled chickpeas dressed with oil and lemon, on toasted garlic croutons.
Ceci lessati e passati, cotti con aglio: Boiled chickpeas, puréed and cooked with garlic and sage in vegetable broth, served with croûtons, oil and parmesan.
Ceci secchi cotti a lungo, passati al se: Dried chickpeas cooked for a long time, passed through a sieve and thinned, served with bread.
Cefali cotti mezz'ora in tegame con olio: Grey mullet cooked for half an hour in a pan with oil, butter, onion, sage and parsley.
Cefali non sventrati, arrostiti sulla br: Grey mullet, not gutted, roasted over embers with salt and pepper and dressed with their own fat.
Cervella e fegatini nel brodo legato con: Brains and chicken livers in a broth bound with eggs, herbs and lemon, poured over bread.
Cervello a pezzi in farina e uovo, fritt: Brains in pieces coated in flour and egg, fried in oil with golden cubes of bread.
Cervello di vitello rosolato con cipolli: Calf's brains browned with small onions in butter and stewed with white wine.
Cervello marinato al limone, impanato e: Brains marinated in lemon, breaded and browned in butter like little meatballs.
Cestini croccanti di pasta fillo riempit: Crisp filo pastry baskets filled with apples cooked with orange juice, honey and cinnamon, and toasted almonds.
Cestini di pasta ripieni di ricotta e za: Pastry baskets filled with ricotta and saffron, scented with orange. They are served at room temperature at Easter, often dusted with sugar.
Cetrioli a fette lasciati spurgare la lo: Sliced cucumbers left to release their water and dressed with oil, vinegar and salt.
Cetrioli a fette salati e scolati, mesco: Sliced cucumbers, salted and drained, mixed with potatoes, celery or tomato and dressed.
Cetrioli a fettine sottili conditi con y: Thinly sliced cucumbers dressed with yoghurt, dill or mint, oil and a pinch of salt.
Chiudere a quadri, lessare e servire col: Close in squares, boil and serve with tomato sauce and basil.
Cialde all'anice cotte nei testi e arrot: Aniseed wafers cooked in the testi and rolled into cones, the wedding sweet.
Cialde bagnate e ripiene di vitello, ani: Wafers moistened and filled with veal, sweetbreads and artichokes, breaded and fried.
Cialde croccanti di farina, zucchero e l: Crisp wafers of flour, sugar and lard cooked in the iron and rolled while hot.
Cialde croccanti di parmigiano arrotolat: Crisp parmesan wafers rolled into cannoli, filled with ricotta and asparagus and finished with chopped pistachios.
Ciambella di besciamella bianca e verde,: A ring of white and green béchamel, with the centre filled with stewed giblets.
Ciambella di casa al burro e limone, inc: A home-made ring cake with butter and lemon, scored, glazed with egg and baked.
Ciambella di frolla allo strutto ripiena: A ring of strutto shortcrust filled with dried figs, nuts and candied peel.
Ciambella di mandorle, zucchero e albumi: A ring cake of almonds, sugar and whisked egg whites, the cake of San Biagio.
Ciambella di pasta lievitata al burro e: A ring of leavened dough with butter and yolks, filled with stewed mushrooms.
Ciambella di riso al latte caramellata,: A caramelised ring of rice cooked in milk, with the centre filled with apples in kirsch.
Ciambella lievitata all'anice con uvetta: A leavened aniseed ring cake with raisins, the sweet symbol of Lucca. Soft and scented with aniseed, it is eaten in slices, also dipped in wine.
Ciambella lievitata con strutto, salumi,: A yeasted ring with strutto, cured meats, cheeses and hard-boiled eggs in the dough. Rich and savoury, it is served in slices warm or at room temperature: the Neapolitan Easter rustico.
Ciambella pasquale perugina colorata di: A Perugian Easter ring cake coloured with Alchermes, with meringue and sprinkles. Red inside and white with meringue outside, it is served in slices at Easter.
Ciambella scottata in acqua bollente pri: A ring cake scalded in boiling water before baking. Hard outside and soft inside: it is eaten at breakfast or with wine.
Ciambella soffice di fecola col buco rie: A soft potato-flour ring cake with the hole filled with hot Marsala zabaione.
Ciambelline di pasta di mandorle e fior: Little rings of almond paste and orange flower, baked until golden.
Cicale di mare lessate, sgusciate, passa: Mantis shrimps boiled, shelled, dipped in flour and egg and fried in oil.
Cicale intere in umido con aglio, prezze: Whole mantis shrimps stewed with garlic, parsley and tomato, on toasted bread.
Ciliegie cotte nel vino con chiodi di ga: Cherries cooked in wine with cloves and cinnamon, on soaked sponge cake.
Ciliegie e susine nere cotte col vino ro: Cherries and black plums cooked with red wine, sugar and spices in a little bag.
Cilindretti di pangrattato, parmigiano e: Little cylinders of breadcrumbs, parmesan and eggs pressed out with the iron and cooked in broth. Soft and scented with lemon and nutmeg, they are served in boiling broth.
Cime di broccoli cotte a poco a poco in: Broccoli tops cooked little by little in a broth of water and oil boiled for hours: they stay bright green and are served with their clear broth.
Cime di luppolo selvatico lessate e cond: Wild hop shoots boiled and dressed with oil and vinegar, with a slightly bitter taste.
Cime di rapa stufate in padella con olio: Turnip tops stewed in the frying pan with oil, garlic, anchovies and chilli, the Puglia winter side dish.
Cinghiale marinato e cotto tra due strat: Wild boar marinated and cooked between two layers of lard, with heat below and above.
Cinghiale rosolato con cipolla e prosciu: Wild boar browned with onion and ham, finished in a black truffle sauce.
Cioccolato sciolto in acqua e zucchero,: Chocolate melted in water and sugar, boiled twice and frozen in the sorbet maker.

Ciotola di farro con tonno, avocado, eda: A bowl of farro with tuna, avocado, edamame and carrots, dressed with a sauce of peanut butter, soy sauce and lime.

Fettine di vitello stufate sulla cipolla: Thin slices of veal stewed on onion, finished with tomato, with polenta.
Fettine di vitellone rosolate e finite i: Thin slices of young beef browned and finished in a quick sauce of tomato, garlic and oregano.
Fettine di zucchina grigliate, spalmate: Slices of grilled courgette spread with a cream of chickpeas, capers, curry and rosemary, rolled up and finished with sesame seeds.
Fettine sottili di fegato passate nel la: Thin slices of liver dipped in milk and floured, browned in butter.
Fettine sottilissime di zucca cotte in f: Very thin slices of squash baked with oil, rosemary and paprika until crisp.
Filetti di luccio perca gratinati in for: Pike-perch fillets baked au gratin with bread, almonds and herbs.
Filetti di merluzzo coperti da una panat: Cod fillets covered with a lemon and parsley crust, baked on a bed of asparagus.
Filetti di merluzzo cotti al forno sotto: Cod fillets baked under a crust of breadcrumbs, almonds, sun-dried tomatoes, oregano and chives.
Filetti di merluzzo cotti in padella con: Cod fillets cooked in a frying pan with onion, garlic, green olives and lemon zest, finished with parsley.
Filetti di merluzzo cotti in teglia sopr: Cod fillets baked in a tin on top of roasted potatoes, carrots and cauliflower florets.
Filetti di merluzzo in teglia con un tri: Cod fillets baked in a dish with chopped garlic and parsley, green olives and capers.
Filetti di merluzzo passati nell'uovo e: Cod fillets dipped in egg and breadcrumbs and baked in the oven instead of fried.
Filetti di pesce sciabola arrotolati su: Fillets of scabbardfish rolled round a filling of breadcrumbs, pecorino, parsley and capers and baked in the oven.
Filetti di sgombro marinati 15 minuti in: Mackerel fillets marinated for 15 minutes in salt and sugar, baked for a few minutes with herbs and lemon zest, on sweet-and-sour red onions.
Filetti di sogliola impanati e fritti, p: Fillets of sole breaded and fried, then finished in a pan with white wine.
Filetti di tinca impanati due volte e do: Fillets of tench breadcrumbed twice and browned in butter, with lemon wedges.
Filetto di manzo rosolato con cipolla e: Beef fillet browned with onion and prosciutto, served in a marsala sauce.
Filetto steccato con prosciutto, rosmari: Fillet studded with ham, rosemary and clove, cooked slowly for three hours.
Filoni con mandorle, pinoli e anice, tag: Logs with almonds, pine nuts and aniseed, cut into slices and baked again.
Filoni di farina bianca e gialla in part: Long loaves of white and yellow flour in equal parts, glazed with egg white.
Finocchi cotti nel burro e nel latte, le: Fennel cooked in butter and milk, bound with béchamel, eggs and parmesan.
Finocchi crudi con avocado, arance a pez: Raw fennel with avocado, orange pieces and walnuts, dressed with orange juice and oil.
Finocchio a fettine sottili con arance,: Thinly sliced fennel with oranges, chickpeas and toasted pumpkin seeds, dressed with oil and pepper.
Fiocchetti di sfoglia genovese lessati e: Little bows of Genoese pasta, boiled and dressed with pesto and Parmigiano.
Fiocchi di albume montato cotti nel latt: Puffs of whisked egg white poached in milk, served cold on vanilla custard.
Focaccette fritte di pasta di pane ripie: Small fried focaccias of bread dough filled with leftover meat, eggs and Parmigiano.
Focaccia alta con pomodoro, acciughe, ol: A thick focaccia with tomato, anchovies, Taggiasca olives, garlic and capers. It is the «pizza» of Sanremo: it is eaten warm or at room temperature, in squares.
Focaccia alta e morbida con patate nell': A tall, soft focaccia with potatoes in the dough, cherry tomatoes and olives. Soft inside and crisp underneath, it is eaten warm in pieces.
Focaccia bassa di farina di mais impasta: A low flatbread of maize flour kneaded with hot water and baked, to be eaten with sautéed greens.
Focaccia di pasta di pane impastata con: A focaccia of bread dough kneaded with pork cracklings and pepper, baked in the oven.
Focaccia dolce e bassa con i ciccioli di: A low, sweet focaccia with pork cracklings, dusted with icing sugar.
Focaccia ferrarese di pasta di pane con: A Ferrara focaccia of bread dough with oil, lard and malt, covered with fresh onion during the last rise: the tiràta ala zivola.
Focaccia lievitata col vino bianco e la: A focaccia risen with white wine and chopped sage, rubbed with oil and salt.
Focaccia lievitata di pasta da pane, str: A leavened focaccia of bread dough, lard and diced prosciutto or pancetta: the carsènt of Bologna, for breakfast, a snack or a frugal lunch.
Focaccina di farina di castagne cotta ne: A little chestnut-flour focaccia cooked in the testo between chestnut leaves.
Focaccine di vitello e maiale battuti, c: Patties of minced veal and pork, cooked over embers and finished with truffle.
Foderare con le fette uno stampo da budi: Line with slices a 1.5 liter pudding mold.
Foderare con pellicola 8 coppette di 8 c: Line with film 8 cups of 8 cm.
Foderare con pellicola una ciotola tonda: Line a 2 liter round bowl with film. Dress it with slices of Spanish bread, juxtaposing them well, and bathe them with the liqueur using a brush.
Foderare con pellicola uno stampo da plu: Line a 25 cm plumcake mold with film.
Line two baking trays with baking paper. With a sac à poche form groups of three round domes of 5 cm placed (they must touch each other in cooking); make 8 groups for the base and 8 for the cover, equal.
Foderare fondo e pareti di uno stampo da: Line the bottom and walls of a 1 liter pudding mold with the well-matched Savoiards.
Foderare il fondo di uno stampo da 750 m: Line the bottom of a 750 ml mold with a baking paper disc.
Foderare uno stampo da plumcake da 25 cm: Line a 25 cm plumcake mold with a sheet of hostile paper (or with baking paper).
Foderare uno stampo rettangolare da 20×2: Line a 20×25 cm rectangular mold with an ostia sheet of paper. Keep the toasted almonds warm in the oven at 100 °C.
Foglie di bietola scottate e arrotolate: Blanched chard leaves rolled around a filling of hake cooked in a pan with onion, parsley and chilli, baked with breadcrumbs.
Foglie di boragine passate in pastella d: Borage leaves dipped in a batter of flour and water and fried in oil.
Foglie di cavolo cappuccio scottate, tag: White cabbage leaves blanched, cut into thin strips and marinated for a day with vinegar, garlic, chilli and oregano; pumpkin seeds at the end.
Foglie tenere di dente di leone in insal: Tender dandelion leaves as a salad with oil, vinegar and salt.
Folaghe marinate nell'aceto e stufate co: Coots marinated in vinegar and stewed with tomato; their sauce dresses pappardelle.
Fondere 60 g di burro; passare ogni pall: Melt 60 g of butter; pass every ball in the melted butter and place it with the bottom closure in a rectangular baking pan of 20×30 cm, next to each other.
Forma di pasta ripiena di vitello, picci: A pastry mould filled with veal, pigeon, sweetbread, artichokes, peas and truffle.
Formare 2 cupole di circa 12 cm di diame: Form 2 domes of about 12 cm of diameter and place them on the pan.
Formare cilindri di 10-12 cm e intreccia: Form 10-12 cm cylinders and cast off two.
Formare cilindri di 3 cm di diametro, ta: Form cylinders of 3 cm of diameter, cut them into pieces of 2 cm and crush them in lozenge (elongated rhombus shape) of about 6 cm.
Formare cilindri di 3 cm, tagliarli a pe: Form 3 cm cylinders, cut into pieces of 5 cm and crush into 1 cm thick oval biscuits.
Formare cordoncini di 1,5 cm e tagliarli: Form 1.5 cm strings and cut into small pieces of 2 cm.
Formare cordoni spessi 3 cm, tagliarli a: Form 3 cm thick cords, cut into pieces of 6 cm and bend them slightly to the crescent (or crush them oval).
Formare dei dischi di 6 centimetri di di: Form discs 6 cm in diameter and 1 cm thick and place them on the pan.
Formare serpentelli di 2 cm e chiuderli: Form 2 cm snakes and close them in 5 cm doughnuts.
Formare sulle teglie degli anelli di 5 c: Form on the trays of the rings of 5 cm or of the poles with “S” spaced.
Formare sulle teglie dei bottoncini di 1: Form on the trays of buttons of 1.5 cm of diameter, spaced 1 cm.
Formare un cilindro di 50 cm e chiuderlo: Form a 50 cm cylinder and close it with a doughnut on a baking tray lined with baking paper.
Formare un filone di 50 cm e chiuderlo a: Form a 50 cm thread and close it with doughnut on a baking tray with baking paper (or leave it in a thread). Cover and leave to rise 1 hour.
Formare un filone e chiuderlo a ciambell: Form a thread and close it with a doughnut of about 24 cm.
Formare una palla e metterla in uno stam: Form a ball and put it in a 22 cm high buttered mold (or on a pan, dome). Let rise again 2 hours.
Fragole congelate e frullate con zuccher: Frozen strawberries blended with icing sugar and lemon zest: a sorbet without an ice-cream maker.
Fragole passate con succo d'arancia e li: Strawberries puréed with orange and lemon juice and syrup, frozen in the ice-cream maker.
Fragole, kiwi, banana e mirtilli frullat: Strawberries, kiwi, banana and blueberries blended with milk and frozen in moulds.
Frattaglie d'agnello con cipolla, vino b: Lamb's pluck with onion, white wine and chilli. Savoury and a little hot: it is served hot, with bread.
Fregula fatta a mano, scottata e passata: Hand-made fregula, boiled and baked in layers with sauce and pecorino.
Friggere a parte il pane nero a crostini: Fry aside the black bread in the melted butter.
Friggere fette di polenta nel grasso rac: Fry slices of polenta in the collected fat and serve with the torrians.
Friggere la polenta a fette nel grasso r: Fry the polenta in slices in the collected fat.
Friggere nel burro il pane a cubetti e u: Fry the cube bread in the butter and add it to the soup with the Fontina and the dice toma.
Fry in boiling oil and serve.
Friggere nello strutto caldo, far raffre: Fry in the hot lard, let cool and sprinkle with icing sugar.
Friggere poche zucchine per volta senza: Fry a few zucchini at a time without touching them for the first minute, because they do not break.
Friggerla nell'olio di semi ben caldo e: Fry it in hot seed oil and drain it.
Friggerle brevemente nell'olio caldo, gi: Fry them briefly in hot oil, turning them once.
Friggerle nell'olio bollente, scolarle e: Fry them in boiling oil, drain and immediately pass into the sugar semolate.
Friggerle nell'olio caldo e servirle cal: Fry them in hot oil and serve them hot.
Friselle ammorbidite, spalmate di crema: Softened friselle spread with bean cream and topped with roasted peppers and sautéed prawns.
Friselle strofinate d'aglio e spalmate c: Friselle rubbed with garlic and spread with a cream of cauliflower, feta and turmeric, with sesame and flax seeds.
Frittata al forno arrotolata attorno a f: An oven-baked omelette rolled round fontina and stewed spinach, returned to the oven so that the cheese melts.
Frittata al forno con melanzane rosolate: An oven-baked omelette with browned aubergines, cherry tomatoes, olives and basil.
Frittata alta con rafano grattugiato, pa: A thick frittata with grated horseradish, potatoes and pecorino. Thick and soft, pungent with horseradish: it is eaten hot or cold, in wedges.
Frittata alta con ricotta, soppressata,: A thick frittata with ricotta, soppressata, pecorino and mint, taken on the Easter Monday picnic.
Frittata alta di asparagi stufati con la: A thick frittata of asparagus stewed with onion, eggs and grana, baked in the oven without turning, until it has a light crust.
Frittata alta di molte uova con salumi e: A thick frittata of many eggs with cured meats and cheese, for Easter Day.
Frittata genovese con mollica di pane ba: A Genoese frittata with soaked breadcrumb, Parmigiano and parsley.
Frittata morbida con latte, formaggio ed: A soft omelette with milk, cheese and herbs, in butter, to serve piping hot.
Frittata senza uova fatta con farina di: An egg-free omelette made with chickpea flour and water, with small pieces of courgette, baked in the oven.
Frittata soffice di uova, farina e latte: A fluffy omelette of eggs, flour and milk with whisked egg whites, rolled up.
Frittatine verdi sottili come carta, tag: Green omelettes as thin as paper, cut into taglierini and tossed in butter.
Frittelle croccanti di grano saraceno co: Crisp buckwheat fritters with a heart of melted Casera. Small and round, they are eaten hot, freshly fried, on a bed of chicory.
Frittelle di Carnevale con uvetta e pino: Carnival fritters with raisins and pine nuts, rolled in sugar. Soft and sugary, they are eaten warm at Carnival.
Frittelle di farina di castagne al rum e: Chestnut-flour fritters with rum and rosemary, filled with sheep's ricotta.
Frittelle di farina di ceci con maggiora: Chickpea-flour fritters with marjoram, cousins of panissa. Puffed and light, they are eaten hot, freshly fried.
Frittelle di farina di ceci servite nel: Chickpea-flour fritters served in a sesame roll. Hot and crisp: they are eaten at once, standing, with lemon.
Frittelle di riso cotto nel latte con sc: Fritters of rice cooked in milk with lemon zest, for 19 March. Soft and scented with lemon: they are eaten warm, rolled in sugar.
Frittelle di semolino cotto nel latte co: Fritters of semolina cooked in milk with eggs, rum and lemon, with icing sugar.
Frittelle genovesi di pastella lievitata: Genoese fritters of yeast batter with lettuce or herbs. Light and crisp, they are eaten hot, freshly fried.
Frittelle natalizie di pasta lievitata,: Christmas fritters of yeasted dough, coated in honey or sugar. Soft and sweet, they are eaten at Christmas, hot or warm.
Frittelle salate di farina di ceci cotte: Savoury chickpea-flour pancakes cooked in a pan and served with lemon-marinated salmon, spring onion, cherry tomatoes and rocket.
Frittelle soffici di ricotta, uova e far: Soft Carnival fritters of ricotta, eggs and flour, rolled in sugar.
Frittelle sottili di farina e acqua cott: Thin fritters of flour and water cooked on the Romagna testo with a drizzle of oil and a pinch of sugar: the «pancakes» of the peasants of the Rimini area.
Frittura dolce e salata: carni, frattagl: A sweet and savoury fry-up: meats, offal, vegetables, sweet semolina and amaretti. It is brought to the table in waves, freshly fried: it is the feast-day dish of Piedmont.
Frolla ripiena di semolino cotto nel lat: Shortcrust filled with semolina cooked in milk with pine nuts, closed with a lattice.
Frullato denso di albicocche, carote e m: A thick smoothie of apricots, carrots and green apple with almond milk, honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
Frutta cotta al forno sotto una copertur: Fruit baked under a topping of crunchy crumbs of flour, oat flakes, almonds and a little butter.
Frutta d'estate a pezzetti con zucchero: Summer fruit in small pieces with sugar and lemon, frozen in a mould like marble.
Funghi freschi soffritti con aglio, poi: Fresh mushrooms fried with garlic, then enclosed in eggs, breadcrumb and oregano.
Funghi pleurotus e porcini saltati, aspa: Sautéed oyster mushrooms and porcini, boiled asparagus and rocket, with a sauce of oven-roasted tomatoes blended with herbs and vinegar.
Fusilli con punte di asparagi rosolate c: Fusilli with asparagus tips browned with shallot, tuna in oil and parsley.
Fusilli con totani cotti nel vino bianco: Fusilli with flying squid cooked in white wine, coated in a blended sauce of boiled asparagus and toasted almonds.
Fusilli con vongole aperte in padella, a: Fusilli with clams opened in the frying pan, asparagus rounds and grated lemon zest.
Fusilli fatti al ferretto conditi col ra: Fusilli made on the rod, dressed with Sunday ragù and caciocavallo. A long-cooked ragù of meats, red and thick: the Sunday dish in the Cilento.
Fusilli integrali su una crema di pisell: Wholemeal fusilli on a cream of peas and mint, with whole peas, chopped pistachios and lemon zest.
Galletta grattugiata e tostata, versata: Grated, toasted ship's biscuit, poured into boiling broth and served with Parmigiano.
Gallina ripiena di fegatini, uova, pomod: A hen stuffed with livers, eggs, sun-dried tomatoes and saffron, boiled and then finished on the embers.
Gamberetti grigi della laguna fritti o l: Grey lagoon shrimps, fried or boiled, served on soft white polenta. Small and sweet, they are eaten with soft white polenta: a Venetian antipasto.
Gelato veloce senza gelatiera: polpa d'a: A quick ice cream without an ice-cream maker: frozen orange flesh blended with sugar and yogurt.
Germano stufato con cipolla e prosciutto: Mallard stewed with onion and ham, surrounded by broccoli flavoured in its juices.
Girello di manzo cotto piano nel suo sug: Beef silverside cooked slowly in its own juices, with just salt and pepper: the garetto of Bologna.
Gnocchetti di farina e acqua bollente, c: Little dumplings of flour and boiling water, dressed with melted butter and toasted breadcrumbs.
Gnocchetti di farina tostata nello strut: Little dumplings of flour toasted in lard, dressed with browned onions.
Gnocchetti di pane bagnato nel latte con: Little dumplings of bread soaked in milk with egg and butter, cooked gently in broth.
Gnocchetti di pane e farina con sugo di: Little dumplings of bread and flour with a sauce of borlotti beans and tomato. A poor, filling dish: it is served hot, with parmesan.
Gnocchetti di patate cotte nel latte, fr: Little potato dumplings cooked in milk, fried and tossed in sugar and cinnamon.
Gnocchetti di polenta dolce al latte, co: Little dumplings of sweet milk polenta, dressed with sugar, cinnamon and melted butter.
Gnocchetti di ricotta di Viceno e spinac: Little gnocchi of Viceno ricotta and spinach, dressed with butter and sage.
Gnocchetti di ricotta e parmigiano senza: Little dumplings of ricotta and parmesan without pasta or greens, with meat sauce.
Gnocchetti di semolino cotto nel latte c: Little dumplings of semolina cooked in milk with butter, egg and cheese, in broth.
Gnocchetti di vitello e prosciutto pesta: Little dumplings of pounded veal and prosciutto, bound with bread and egg, cooked in broth.
Gnocchetti morbidi di ricotta, bietole e: Soft little gnocchi of ricotta, chard and wholemeal flour, without eggs, served on a curried carrot cream.
Gnocchetti rigati di semola e zafferano: Ridged semolina and saffron gnocchetti with sausage sauce and pecorino. Small and ridged, they hold the sauce well: it is one of the best-known first courses of Sardinia.
Gnocchetti verdi di spinaci passati nell: Little green spinach dumplings pushed through the special tool, with cream and speck. Soft and irregular: they are served at once, hot.
Gnocchettini di burro, uova e pangrattat: Tiny dumplings of butter, eggs and breadcrumbs cooked over a moderate heat in broth.
Gnocchi allungati di ricotta, erbe e for: Elongated gnocchi of ricotta, greens and cheese, cooked in broth and browned in the oven. They are served hot and gratinated: a typical dish of the Alessandria area.
Gnocchi di pane bianco ammollato nel lat: Dumplings of white bread soaked in milk with eggs, boiled and dressed with butter.
Gnocchi di pane raffermo e spinaci, con: Dumplings of stale bread and spinach, with melted butter, sage and grana. Soft and full of flavour: they are served hot with melted butter, just drained.
Gnocchi di patate con farina di castagne: Potato gnocchi with chestnut flour, dressed with walnut and pine-nut sauce.
Gnocchi di patate con sugo di pomodoro,: Potato gnocchi with tomato sauce, stringy mozzarella and basil, gratinated. They are served hot in small baking dishes, with the mozzarella stretching into strings.
Gnocchi di patate e farina a truciolo, a: Curled gnocchi of potato and flour, in layers with pesto and Parmigiano.
Gnocchi di patate saltati con gambi di a: Potato gnocchi tossed with asparagus stalks in rounds, whole tips and cherry tomatoes added at the last moment.
Gnocchi di patate veronesi conditi con b: Verona potato gnocchi dressed with melted butter, grana cheese and a little sugar and cinnamon, as on the venerdì gnocolar.
Gnocchi di polenta di grano saraceno all: Dumplings of buckwheat polenta made with oil, dressed with butter and cheese.
Gnocchi di semolino cotto nel latte e le: Dumplings of semolina cooked in milk and bound with eggs, boiled and dressed with butter.
Gnocchi rustici fatti solo con broccoli: Rustic gnocchi made only with boiled broccoli and flour, tossed with garlicky chard and sun-dried tomatoes.
Gran fetta di vitello arrotolata su anim: A large slice of veal rolled around sweetbread, ham and vegetables, excellent cold.
Grande fetta di manzo arrotolata su un r: A large slice of beef rolled around a filling of veal, tongue and prosciutto, roasted.
Grande frittata con listelle di prosciut: A large frittata with fried strips of ham, parsley and breadcrumbs.
Grande guscio di pasta sfoglia ripieno d: A large puff-pastry shell filled with sweetbreads, chicken livers and truffle.
Grande lievitato natalizio con uvetta e: A large leavened Christmas bread with raisins and candied orange and citron. Tall and soft, it is served in wedges at Christmas, on its own or with mascarpone cream.
Grande pasticcio freddo di lepre marinat: A large cold pie of hare marinated in marsala, with tongue and truffle.
Grandi cappellacci ripieni di zucca viol: Large cappellacci filled with violina pumpkin and Parmigiano, with butter and sage or ragù. A sweet pumpkin filling, dressed with butter and sage: the autumn first course of Ferrara.
Granelli di montone lessati, a filetti,: Ram's fries boiled, cut into strips, floured, dipped in egg and fried.
Granita cremosa di mandorle siciliane se: A creamy granita of Sicilian almonds served with the brioche col tuppo (topknot brioche). Cool and creamy, it is the summer breakfast in Sicily: the brioche is dunked in it.
Grano cotto con melagrana, noci, cioccol: Cooked wheat with pomegranate, walnuts, chocolate and vincotto, for 2 November. It is served cold, in small bowls, on the Day of the Dead.
Grigliata di pesce azzurro dell'Adriatic: A grill of Adriatic oily fish: sardines and saraghine coated with breadcrumbs, oil and parsley and cooked over a fierce heat on the grill, also inside a piadina.
Grossi gnocchi di pane raffermo, speck e: Large dumplings of stale bread, speck and eggs, cooked and served in broth. The size of a mandarin, scented with speck: they are served in soup plates with hot broth.
Grossi spaghetti integrali con salsa di: Thick wholemeal spaghetti with a sauce of stewed onions and anchovies. Rough, full-flavoured pasta, a sauce sweet with onion and salty with anchovy: it is the Venetian meatless dish.
Grumetti di farina e acqua cotti nel lat: Little lumps of flour and water cooked in milk, sprinkled with pepper or sugar.
Grumi sferici di semola 'benedetta' con: Round lumps of «blessed» semolina with water, dressed with tomato sauce. Small and irregular, they gather up the sauce: they are served hot with cheese.
Guscio di frolla con pan di Spagna, crem: A shortcrust case with sponge cake, custard and a baked meringue topping.
Guscio di pasta brisée con una crema di: A shell of shortcrust (brisée) with a cream of blended mushrooms and peas and asparagus tips on top.
Guscio di pasta frolla cotto a parte, ri: A shortcrust pastry case baked blind, filled with custard and topped with strawberries and blueberries.
Hamburger di lenticchie frullate con car: Burgers of blended lentils with carrot, maize flour, curry and capers, browned in a pan and served with lemon.
Hamburger di patate e zucchine lessate c: Burgers of boiled potatoes and courgettes with carrot and onion, egg and Parmigiano, breaded and baked.
Hamburger di patate, carote, piselli e f: Burgers of boiled potatoes, carrots, peas and green beans chopped with bread soaked in vinegar, browned in a pan.
Hamburger vegetali di zucchine, fagioli: Vegetable burgers of courgettes, cannellini beans and onion, baked and served in a bun with tomato and mozzarella.
I pasticcini morbidi di sole mandorle, z: Soft little pastries of only almonds, sugar and egg white, without flour: crisp outside and tender inside.
I primi fichi ancora verdi, incisi a cro: The first figs, still green, cut with a cross, boiled and then dipped in flour and egg and fried: an early-summer fry of the Neapolitan kitchen that throws nothing away.
Il ripieno dei cappelletti, ricotta e pe: The filling of cappelletti, ricotta and chicken breast, cooked by the teaspoonful in broth.
Il tondone, frittata di farina e acqua,: The tondone, a frittata of flour and water, pounded with eggs and fried into bombe.
Imburrare e infarinare una tortiera di 2: Butter and flour a cake tin of 26 cm with the butter kept aside and the flour, and pour in the dough leveling it.
Imburrare una teglia da 28 cm e stenderv: Butter a 28 cm baking pan and spread the dough with your hands in a 2 cm layer. Let rise again 1 hour.
Imburrare una teglia di 22 cm; stendere: Butter a 22 cm baking sheet; spread two thirds of the cut-off at 4 mm thick and cover the bottom and edges.
Imburrare una teglia di 24 cm con il bur: Butter a 24 cm baking pan with the remaining butter and pour in the mixture.
Imburrare una teglia di 26 cm con il bur: Butter a 26 cm baking pan with the remaining butter and pour in the mixture, leveling it.
Imburrare una teglia di 26 cm e premere: Butter a 26 cm baking tray and press the dough with your fingers in a layer of 1.5 cm, leaving the surface irregular.
Imburrare una teglia di 26 cm e versare: Butter a pan of 26 cm and pour the mixture.
Imburrare una teglia di 26 cm, versarvi: Butter a pan of 26 cm, pour in the mixture and distribute over a few bows of butter.
Imburrare una teglia di 28 cm, versarvi: Butter a 28 cm baking pan, pour in the mixture and level it to 2-3 cm.
Imburrare una teglia rettangolare di 20×: Butter a rectangular baking tray of 20×30 cm and pour the dough into it, leveling it.
Imburrare una tortiera di 24 cm e stende: Butter a 24 cm cake pan and spread the mixture.
Imburrare uno stampo a ciambella alto da: Butter a 24 cm tall doughnut mold and put in the dough, deflated and elongated with dough.
Imburrare uno stampo a stella da pandoro: Butter a pandoro star mold (or a 24 cm high mold), put the dough in the dough deflated and rounded and let it rise again 2-3 hours, until it reaches 2 cm from the edge.
Imburrare uno stampo alto da 22 cm (o da: Butter a 22 cm high mould (or low panettone), put in the rounded dough and let it rise again 1 hour and a half.
Imburrare uno stampo alto da panettone (: Butter a panettone mold (or two 20 cm molds) and put the dough in it: it must be filled in half.
Imburrare uno stampo da charlotte o da 1: Butter a Charlotte or 18 cm mold at high edges. Cut some slices into triangles for the bottom and others into strips for the sides; brush them with melted butter on both sides and cover the mould, overlapping them slightly.
Imburrare uno stampo di 18 cm, spolveriz: Butter an 18 cm mold, sprinkle with icing sugar and flour, pour the dough and cook in the oven at 170 °C for 35 minutes, until the toothpick comes out dry; let it cool completely.

Involtini di vitello ripieni, fasciati n: Stuffed veal rolls, wrapped in lard and roasted between crostini and sage.

Lattuga tritata e arrostita nel burro, c: Chopped lettuce roasted in butter, cooked in broth and poured over white bread.
Lattuga, patate, barbabietole, acciughe: Lettuce, potatoes, beetroot, anchovies and boiled fish covered with mayonnaise.
Lattughe e funghi secchi cotti con panna: Lettuces and dried mushrooms cooked with cream, eggs and marjoram, poured over bread.

Lievitato a stella, alto e burroso, serv: A star-shaped leavened cake, tall and buttery, served with vanilla icing sugar. Tall and buttery, star-shaped: it is served in slices at Christmas.
Lievitato pasquale dolce arricchito di c: A sweet Easter bread enriched with chocolate, a legacy of the port's trade. Tall and soft, it is eaten in slices at breakfast, at Easter.
Lievitato soffice a fungo inzuppato di s: A soft, mushroom-shaped yeasted cake soaked in rum syrup. Soft and moist with syrup, it is served cold, also with cream or custard.
Limone cotto e pestato con uova montate,: A cooked, pounded lemon with whisked eggs, sugar and ground almonds, baked in the oven.
Lingua di maiale salata bollita adagio,: Salted pig's tongue boiled slowly, skinned and served with horseradish sauce.
Lingua di manzo salata e affumicata, bol: Salted, smoked ox tongue, boiled for a long time and served in slices with cabbage.
Lingua di manzo spellata e stufata col b: Ox tongue skinned and stewed with the battuto and tomato, in a thickened sauce.
Lingua di vitello stufata e finita con c: Calf's tongue stewed and finished with chocolate, pine nuts, raisins, candied peel and vinegar.

Lingua e guancia di vitello bollite a pa: Calf's tongue and cheek boiled separately and served with salsa verde.
Lingua lardellata cotta adagio tra fette: Larded tongue cooked slowly between slices of ham and beef, with herbs and mushrooms.
Lingua salmistrata otto giorni sotto sal: Tongue cured for eight days under salt, boiled for a long time and served cold in slices.
Linguine con gamberetti al lardo e una s: Linguine with shrimps in lard and a raw rocket sauce, with pecorino.
Listarelle di sogliola marinate al limon: Strips of sole marinated in lemon, dipped in milk and flour and fried.

Lombata d'agnello rosolata nello strutto: Lamb loin browned in lard and bound with eggs just set.
Lombata di capriolo marinata un giorno c: Loin of roe deer marinated for a day with lemon, aromatics and spices, roasted with butter.
Lombata di cinghiale marinata un giorno: Loin of wild boar marinated for a day with herbs and lemon, then roasted on the spit.

Lombata di manzo salata e cotta coperta: Beef loin salted and cooked covered in butter, by steam, served with salad.
Lombata di manzo senza filetto, steccata: Beef loin without the fillet, studded with truffle and butter and cooked on the spit.
Lombata di vitello legata e girata allo: Loin of veal tied and turned on the spit, brushed often with melted butter.
Lombata di vitello steccata d'aglio e ro: Veal loin studded with garlic and rosemary, cooked in a pan; peas in the sauce.
Lombata disossata, farcita di vitello, p: A boned loin, stuffed with veal, prosciutto and parmesan, cooked in marsala.
Lombata steccata con aglio e rosmarino,: Pork loin studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted in the oven; broccoli in its juices.
Lombo aperto a libro, farcito di vitello: A loin opened like a book, stuffed with veal, mortadella and marrow, cooked in caul fat.
Lonza cotta in forno su un letto di seda: Pork loin baked on a bed of celery, carrots and onions, which are then puréed to make the sauce.
Losanghe di pasta all'uovo, vino e salvi: Fried diamonds of dough with egg, wine and sage, to eat with prosciutto.
Luccio cotto piano in acqua, aceto e odo: Pike poached gently in water, vinegar and aromatics, with a warm sauce of eggs and lemon.
Lumache nel guscio cotte sulla brace con: Snails in their shells cooked over embers with a pinch of salt and two drops of oil.

Maccheroncelli cotti per metà in acqua e: Maccheroncelli cooked halfway in water and finished in boiling milk, dressed with provola and mozzarella and enclosed in a case of shortcrust in the oven: the «white» timpano of Neapolitan court cooking.
Maccheroni a strati con sugo di manzo, p: Macaroni in layers with beef sauce, Parmigiano and sausage, baked in the oven.
Maccheroni col condimento bollente di la: Macaroni with a boiling dressing of diced smoked lard and butter.
Maccheroni col sugo di alzavola tritata,: Macaroni with a sauce of chopped teal, prosciutto, dried mushrooms and tomato.
Maccheroni col sugo di piccione, rigagli: Maccheroni with a sauce of pigeon, giblets, prosciutto, mushrooms and balsamella, in a shortcrust case.
Maccheroni col sugo passato di vitello,: Macaroni with a sieved sauce of veal, onion and tomato; the meat as a main course.
Maccheroni con un sugo veloce di pomodor: Maccheroni with a quick sauce of cherry tomatoes, julienned courgettes, strips of fresh tuna and blanched asparagus.

Maccheroni conditi con una crema di cavo: Macaroni dressed with a cream of cauliflower and leek sautéed with curry and blended with walnuts.
Maccheroni conditi nel piatto caldo con: Macaroni dressed on a hot dish with fresh butter and plenty of Parmigiano.
Maccheroni cotti nell'acqua delle melanz: Macaroni cooked in the aubergine water and dressed with pesto and Parmigiano.
Maccheroni grossi freschi farciti di vit: Large fresh macaroni stuffed with veal and sweetbread, baked in a dish in the sauce.
Maccheroni nella balsamella con groviera: Maccheroni in balsamella with gruyère and parmesan, gratinated with breadcrumbs.
Magro di manzo lardellato e cotto copert: Lean beef larded and cooked covered with water with carrot and celery, then with wine.
Magro di vitello lardellato, cotto in ac: Lean veal larded, cooked in water with sage and rosemary, finished with marsala.
Magro di vitello rosolato nel burro, cot: Lean veal browned in butter, cooked with tomato and finished with fresh peas.
Magro di vitello steccato di prosciutto,: Lean veal studded with prosciutto, cooked slowly in butter with onion, celery and carrot.
Maiale cotto con cipolle, aceto, vino bi: Pork cooked with onions, vinegar, white wine and lemon, with reduced juices and boiled potatoes.
Maiale infarinato, rosolato nello strutt: Floured pork, browned in lard with onions and stewed in tomato.
Maialino da latte arrostito lentamente a: Suckling pig roasted slowly on the spit and served on myrtle leaves. The rind turns crisp, the meat stays tender: it is eaten hot, in pieces.
Mandorle a filetti nello zucchero carame: Slivered almonds in caramelised sugar, spread thin in a mould.
Mandorle caramellate in tre passate di z: Almonds caramelised in three coatings of sugar, crunchy and sandy.
Mandorle di pasta sottile fritte che si: Diamonds of thin dough fried until they puff up, dusted with icing sugar.
Mandorle di semolino al latte impanate e: Diamonds of semolina cooked in milk, breadcrumbed and fried, a sweet side to meat fries.

Manzo a tocchi rosolato nel burro con gl: Chunks of beef browned in butter with aromatics, stewed with tomato and mushrooms.
Manzo cotto cinque ore in pentola chiusa: Beef cooked for five hours in a closed pot with onion, oil and vinegar, tender enough for a spoon.
Manzo cotto lentamente nel vino rosso co: Beef cooked slowly in red wine with onions and spices, served with polenta. Dark, tender meat in a thick onion sauce: it is served hot with polenta.
Manzo lardellato, tenuto nell'aceto fort: Larded beef, kept in strong vinegar and cooked quickly in butter over a fierce heat.
Manzo marinato nel vino, steccato di lar: Beef marinated in wine, studded with lard and cloves, cooked slowly.
Manzo rosolato con anisetta, spezie e od: Beef browned with anisette, spices and aromatics, then stewed in white wine and tomato.
Manzo steccato con lardo e chiodi di gar: Beef studded with lard and cloves, turned on the spit with potatoes.
Manzo stufato due ore su un soffritto d': Beef stewed for two hours on a soffritto of oil, parsley and garlic, without tomato.
Manzo stufato nel burro con porro, radic: Beef stewed in butter with leek, roots and marjoram, a drop of vinegar and tomato.
Manzo stufato su soffritto di strutto e: Beef stewed on a soffritto of lard and vegetables, with cinnamon and tomato.
Manzo stufato tre ore nel burro con acet: Beef stewed for three hours in butter with vinegar and cream, served in slices with the sauce.

Marroni lessati e passati con zucchero,: Chestnuts boiled and sieved with sugar, rum and vanilla, served on a plate as a dessert.
Marroni lessati e passati, cotti col lat: Chestnuts boiled and puréed, cooked with milk and vanilla sugar, then frozen.
Mattoncini di besciamella, uova e parmig: Little bricks of béchamel, eggs and parmesan cooked in a bain-marie and then in broth.
Mazzancolle arrostite sulla griglia senz: Prawns roasted on the grill without dressing, then shelled and dressed with lemon.
Medaglioni di coscia di vitello tritata,: Medallions of minced leg of veal, breaded and browned in butter.
Melanzane a tocchetti insaporite nel bur: Aubergine chunks flavoured in butter and finished in tomato sauce.
Melanzane a tocchetti salate, infarinate: Aubergines in chunks, salted, floured and fried in oil, as Artusi liked them.

Mele cotte nel succo d'arancia e frullat: Apples cooked in orange juice and blended, served in small bowls with chopped hazelnuts and cocoa: a dessert without sugar.
Mele cotte nel vino bianco, coperte di c: Apples cooked in white wine, covered with pastry cream and meringue browned in the oven.

Merluzzo lessato e sbriciolato, mescolat: Cod boiled and flaked, mixed with mashed potato and sage and browned in the oven with grana.
Merluzzo marinato al limone e origano, c: Cod marinated in lemon and oregano, cooked with tomatoes and served with thin oven-baked potatoes with rosemary.

Mezze cipolle ripiene di tonno, mollica,: Onion halves filled with tuna, breadcrumb, eggs and Parmigiano, baked in the oven.
Mezze maniche con ceci in parte schiacci: Mezze maniche with partly mashed chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, tuna, rosemary and chilli.
Mezze melanzane incise a graticola, unte: Aubergine halves scored in a lattice, brushed with oil and cooked covered on the grill.
Mezze pesche col ripieno di amaretti e t: Peach halves with an amaretti and yolk filling, cooked in wine and covered with zabaione.

Mezze zucchine dorate nel burro e copert: Courgette halves browned in butter and covered with beaten eggs that set.
Mezzelune di frolla ripiene di riso, pat: Shortcrust half-moons filled with rice, potatoes, eggs and pecorino, the Easter rustico.
Mezzelune di pasta all'uovo ripiene di c: Half-moons of egg pasta filled with meats and mortadella, with ragù.
Mezzelune di pasta all'uovo ripiene di r: Half-moons of egg pasta filled with ricotta, with butter, grana and tomato.
Mezzelune di pasta frolla ripiene di mar: Half-moons of shortcrust filled with almond marzipan and candied orange.

Mezzelune fritte ripiene di ceci e marro: Fried half-moons filled with chickpeas and chestnuts with sapa, mostarda and cinnamon.
Mezzi pomodori conditi con aglio, origan: Tomato halves topped with garlic, oregano, parsley and cheese, browned slowly.

Miglio lessato e mescolato con melanzane: Boiled millet mixed with stewed aubergines, peppers, courgettes and tomatoes, then browned in the oven with parmesan.
Milza cotta nel burro, tritata con le ac: Spleen cooked in butter, chopped with anchovies and spread on buttered bread.
Minestra cremosa di spinaci e farina di: A creamy soup of spinach and maize flour, a poor Friulian dish. Green and velvety, it is eaten hot, in bowls.
Minestra del piccolo pisello selvatico d: A soup of the small wild pea of Civita di Cascia, with potatoes and sage. Thick and full of flavour, it is served hot with raw oil.
Minestra densa di borlotti in parte pass: A thick soup of borlotti beans, partly puréed, with pork rind, rosemary and short pasta, served with raw oil and pepper.

Pasta condita con una salsa di fave e ci: Pasta dressed with a sauce of blanched broad beans and spring onions, blended with oil, garlic and parmesan.

Pasta corta con un pesto cremoso di zucc: Short pasta with a creamy pesto of blanched courgettes, ricotta, parmesan and basil.
Pasta corta con un sugo di pomodoro, ton: Short pasta with a sauce of tomato, tuna, button mushrooms and cannellini beans, finished with plenty of parsley.
Pasta corta con zucchine a rondelle roso: Short pasta with courgette rounds browned with garlic, coloured by saffron and finished with parsley.
Pasta corta condita con un pesto di broc: Short pasta dressed with a pesto of boiled broccoli blended with pine nuts, garlic, parmesan and oil, plus a few whole florets.

Pasta corta cotta nella stessa acqua del: Short pasta cooked in the same water as the cauliflower, dressed with oil, garlic, anchovies and toasted breadcrumbs.
Pasta corta integrale con asparagi, fagi: Short wholemeal pasta with asparagus, green beans and onion stewed in a pan.
Pasta cotta in pentola e fritta a pallin: A dough cooked in the pan and fried in balls or star-shaped sticks, sugared.
Pasta cotta sul fuoco con burro, zuccher: A paste cooked on the heat with butter, sugar and citron zest, beaten with the eggs and scented with candied citron flowers and amaretti, baked in egg-shaped spoonfuls: little Neapolitan bignè.
Pasta d'uovo asciugata e tritata in bric: Egg pasta dried and chopped into tiny crumbs, cooked in meat broth.
Pasta di acqua e farina a sezione quadra: A pasta of water and flour with a square cross-section, with oil, garlic and Norcia black truffle. A rough, chewy pasta, barely dressed so that the truffle comes through: a dish of Umbria.
Pasta di acqua e farina arrotolata a man: A pasta of water and flour rolled by hand, dressed with Romagna ragù. Thick, rough pasta that holds the sauce well: it is served hot, with parmesan.
Pasta di grano saraceno con un pesto a c: Buckwheat pasta with a raw pesto of boiled asparagus, almonds, garlic and soy drink, scented with lemon thyme.
Pasta di magro con olive, capperi, uvett: Meatless pasta with olives, capers, raisins, pine nuts and anchovies, loved by Leopardi. Savoury and sweet-and-sour, it is served at once, hot.
Pasta di pane fritta in olio e passata n: Bread dough fried in oil and rolled in sugar or filled with cured meats. Puffed and golden, it is eaten hot, sweet or savoury.
Pasta di patate con burro, zucchero, tuo: A potato paste with butter, sugar, yolks, cinnamon and candied citron, baked in the mould.
Pasta dolce al marsala ripiena di frutta: A sweet Marsala pastry filled with seasonal fruit cooked in wine, prunes and citron.
Pasta dura di farina, uova e formaggio g: A stiff dough of flour, eggs and cheese grated into crumbs and cooked in broth.
Pasta fatta in casa a losanghe con ragù: Home-made pasta in diamonds with lamb ragù. Wide, substantial pasta and a savoury ragù: it is served hot with pecorino.
Pasta fresca al latte e basilico con fru: Fresh pasta made with milk and basil, with seafood and cherry tomatoes. Short, thick pasta scented with basil: it is served at once, a dish of the Amalfi Coast.
Pasta fresca arrotolata con sugo di pomo: Fresh rolled pasta with fresh tomato sauce, an old Calabrian recipe. Rustic pasta and a simple sauce: it is served at once, hot.
Pasta fresca con peperoni di Senise essi: Fresh pasta with dried Senise peppers fried crisp and breadcrumbs. The cruschi are sweet and crunchy like crisps: they are crumbled over the pasta.
Pasta fresca di farina e acqua tagliata: Fresh pasta of flour and water cut into diamonds, cooked with beans in a sauce of tomato, lard and chilli.
Pasta fresca in parte lessata e in parte: Fresh pasta partly boiled and partly fried, with stewed chickpeas. A little soft and a little crisp: it is eaten hot, a typical dish of the Salento.
Pasta integrale con finocchi appassiti i: Wholemeal pasta with fennel softened in a pan and fresh mackerel in pieces, finished with orange juice.
Pasta integrale con un pesto crudo di ra: Wholemeal pasta with a raw pesto of radicchio, almonds, garlic and oil, instead of basil.
Pasta integrale con un pesto di edamame,: Wholemeal pasta with a pesto of edamame, almonds and sun-dried tomatoes thinned with the cooking water.
Pasta integrale fredda con piselli, pomo: Cold wholemeal pasta with peas, sun-dried tomatoes in strips, celery, almonds and capers.
Pasta integrale fredda condita con una c: Cold wholemeal pasta dressed with a blended cream of peas, courgettes, Greek yogurt, lemon and mint.
Pasta lunga a sezione quadrata di Irpini: A long, square-section pasta of Irpinia, dressed with ragù. Thick, rough pasta with the Sunday ragù: it is served hot.
Pasta mantecata a crudo con una salsa di: Pasta tossed off the heat with a raw sauce of chopped pine nuts, marjoram, Parmigiano and milk.
Pasta mantecata come un risotto in un su: Pasta finished like a risotto in a sauce of asparagus, dried porcini and pancetta, with parsley and grana.
Pasta mantecata con crema di pecorino ro: Pasta tossed with a cream of pecorino romano and toasted pepper. Few ingredients, a smooth cream sharp with pepper: serve it at once, before it sets.
Pasta mista cotta nelle patate con crost: Mixed pasta cooked with potatoes, cheese rinds and stringy provola. Thick and creamy, with the provola stretching into strings: it is eaten hot.
Pasta ripiena delle feste imolesi, cotta: A filled pasta for festive days in Imola, cooked in broth. Small and delicate, they are served in hot broth with parmesan.
Pasta ripiena di carne, bietola e pane,: Pasta filled with meat, chard and bread, dressed with meat ragù. They are served hot with the ragù and parmesan: the festive first course of the Lucca area.
Pasta ripiena di carne, pane, amaretti e: Pasta filled with meat, bread, amaretti and raisins, with butter, sage and pancetta. A sweet-and-savoury filling, closed like a sweet wrapper: they are served with melted butter and sage.
Pasta ripiena dolce-salata con amaretti,: Sweet-and-savoury filled pasta with amaretti, mostaccino, raisins and citron. They are served with melted butter, sage and grana: it is the festive dish of Crema.
Pasta sfoglia al burro con crema al latt: Butter puff pastry with milk custard and a pastry lattice, baked in the oven.
Pasta sfoglia con zucchine e cipolla sal: Puff pastry with sautéed courgettes and onion, bound with eggs and béchamel and topped with cheese.
Pasta sfoglia con zucchine saltate, rico: Puff pastry with sautéed courgettes, ricotta, egg, Parmigiano and pancetta.
Pasta sfoglia farcita con peperoni salta: Puff pastry filled with sautéed peppers, tuna and cream cheese.
Pasta tirata sottilissima arrotolata su: Paper-thin stretched pastry rolled around apples, raisins, pine nuts and cinnamon. It is served warm, in slices, with icing sugar and, if you like, cream or vanilla sauce.
Pastella di farina di castagne con acini: A chestnut-flour batter with zibibbo grapes, fried and sugared.
Pastella di farina e latte cotta al forn: A batter of flour and milk baked in a buttered pan until golden.
Pastella di farina, latte, tuorli e albu: A batter of flour, milk, yolks and whisked whites, baked for an hour in butter.
Pasticcini di mollica bagnata nel brodo,: Little pastries of breadcrumb soaked in broth, filled with a sweetbread ragù, fried.
Pasticcini di pasta sfoglia ripieni di z: Little puff pastries filled with candied squash and orange zest, baked in the oven.
Pasticcini genovesi di frolla ripieni di: Genoese shortcrust tartlets filled with custard with pistachios, pine nuts and candied fruit.
Pasticcini soffici di uova montate, zucc: Soft little cakes of whisked eggs, sugar and chocolate, baked in paper cases.
Pastinache lessate e condite con olio, s: Parsnips boiled and dressed with oil, salt and fennel seeds pounded in vinegar.
Pastine di frolla alle mandorle tostate,: Little shortcrust biscuits with toasted almonds, rolled with the ridged rolling pin.
Patate a cubetti rosolate in padella con: Diced potatoes browned in a pan with stewed cavolo nero, boiled chickpeas, garlic and rosemary.
Patate a dadini cotte nel soffritto di l: Diced potatoes cooked in a soffritto of lard and onion until they fall apart, with bread.
Patate a pezzi cotte nel brodo con prezz: Potato chunks cooked in broth with parsley and finished in butter, without browning.
Patate al vapore a fette grosse, con oli: Steamed potatoes in thick slices, with oil and vinegar or with Genoese agliata.
Patate crude a fette sottili rosolate ne: Thinly sliced raw potatoes browned in butter, the classic side for steak.
Patate della Sila cotte in padella con c: Sila potatoes cooked in the frying pan with onion until they stick together and form a crust. They are served hot, in wedges, with the golden crust.
Patate e bietole lessate e passate, impa: Potatoes and chard boiled and puréed, mixed with eggs, ricotta, Parmigiano and marjoram and baked in a dish.

Patate in umido con grasso di manzo, bur: Potatoes stewed with beef fat, butter, garlic, rosemary and tomato.
Patate incise a ventaglio arrostite con: Potatoes cut into fans and roasted with white and green asparagus, king oyster mushrooms and cherry tomatoes, served with a chive yoghurt sauce.
Patate intere, costine, salamini e pance: Whole potatoes, spare ribs, small salamis and pancetta cooked for two hours in alpine-pasture butter.
Patate lessate e passate, lavorate a fuo: Potatoes boiled and puréed, worked over a low heat with butter and milk.
Patate lesse a fette rosolate nello stru: Sliced boiled potatoes browned in lard with plenty of onion, until crusty.
Patate lesse pestate con funghi, aglio,: Boiled potatoes mashed with mushrooms, garlic, prescinseua and Parmigiano, baked in the oven.
Patate novelle con la buccia cotte in fo: New potatoes in their skins baked with rosemary, thyme, sage and garlic.
Patate novelle piccole rosolate intere n: Small new potatoes browned whole in butter and finished with parsley.
Patate schiacciate col burro e il latte,: Potatoes mashed with butter and milk, baked in a pan until crusty.
Patate svuotate, ripiene di vitello e an: Hollowed-out potatoes, stuffed with veal and sweetbread and cooked in meat sauce.

Penne cotte nel brodo delle alzavole e c: Penne cooked in the broth of teal and dressed with their meat, butter and parmesan.

Peperoni lunghi ripieni di patate, uova: Long peppers stuffed with potatoes, eggs and pecorino, fried.
Peperoni sott'aceto, cetriolo, melanzane: Pickled peppers, cucumber, aubergines, tomatoes and raw onion in a salad.

Perine sbucciate cotte in uno sciroppo l: Small peeled pears cooked in a light lemon syrup, served cold.
Pernice in crosta con farcia di fegatini: Partridge in pastry with a stuffing of chicken livers, truffle and tongue: it is served cold.
Pernici arrostite allo spiedo e unte d'o: Partridges roasted on the spit and brushed with oil, wrapped in ham if you like.

Pernici lardellate e fasciate di vitello: Partridges larded and wrapped in veal and ham, braised for two hours in wine.
Pernici rosolate nel burro e servite con: Partridges browned in butter and served with a side of spinach.
Pesce bollito negli odori e servito con: Fish boiled with aromatics and served with beetroot, potatoes and hard-boiled eggs.
Pesce cotto in tegame tra due fuochi con: Fish cooked in a dish between two fires with oil, garlic, parsley and dried mushrooms.

Pesce lesso sfilettato in balsamella con: Boiled fish, filleted, in béchamel with parmesan, browned under breadcrumbs.
Pesce minuto cotto in un piatto da forno: Small fish baked in a dish with garlic, parsley, lemon and wine.

Pesche duracine sbucciate cotte piano ne: Peeled clingstone peaches cooked slowly in white wine with sugar and a splash of rum.

Petto di pollo arrosto pestato con mando: Roast chicken breast pounded with almonds and breadcrumb, dissolved in broth over bread.
Petto di vitello aperto a libro e farcit: Breast of veal opened out like a book and stuffed with meat, prosciutto and mortadella, cooked in a pan.
Petto di vitello con le ossa steccato al: Breast of veal on the bone studded with prosciutto, roasted with lard and potatoes.
Petto di vitello di latte in umido col b: Breast of milk-fed veal stewed with a battuto of aromatics, finished with fennel in butter.
Petto di vitello lessato partendo da acq: Veal breast boiled from cold water, with parsley in oil.
Petto e ali di tacchino lessati con radi: Turkey breast and wings boiled with roots, herbs and a battuto of lard.
Pezzetti di pasta di pane lievitata, fri: Pieces of yeasted bread dough, fried and eaten hot, salted or with sugar.
Pezzetti di sedano lessati, saltati nel: Small pieces of celery boiled, tossed in butter and bound with béchamel and parmesan.
Pezzi d'agnello lessati a metà, passati: Pieces of lamb half boiled, dipped in egg and breadcrumbs and fried in lard.
