Pezzi di baccalà infarinati e fritti, co: Pieces of salt cod floured and fried, covered with a sauce of garlic, bread and vinegar.
Pezzi di cardo farciti di cardo, funghi,: Pieces of cardoon filled with cardoon, mushrooms, eggs and Parmigiano, cooked in a dish.
Pezzi di castrato rosolati nel burro e l: Pieces of mutton browned in butter and lard with onions and cloves.
Pezzi di palombo nel soffritto d'aglio e: Pieces of smooth-hound in a soffritto of garlic and parsley, cooked with wine and tomato.
Pezzi di pollo disossato impanati, rosol: Pieces of boned chicken, breaded, browned and finished in a sauce made with the bones.
Pezzi di stoccafisso ammollato passati i: Pieces of soaked stockfish dipped in a water and flour batter and fried.
Pezzo di lesso finito in umido col battu: A piece of boiled beef finished as a stew with the battuto, tomato and dried mushrooms.
Piadina calda farcita con salmone affumi: Hot piadina filled with smoked salmon, lettuce and a fresh sauce of Greek yoghurt, rocket, lemon and chives.
Piadina sfogliata con strutto, farcita d: A flaky flatbread made with lard, filled with wild greens or cured meats. Flaky and crumbly: it is eaten hot, just cooked on the testo.
Piccione allo spiedo con dentro una brac: Spit-roasted pigeon with a beaten veal escalope inside, with butter and spices.
Piccione aperto, scottato nell'olio, pas: Pigeon opened out, seared in oil, dipped in butter, egg and breadcrumbs and grilled.
Piccioni a pezzi con prosciutto, animell: Pigeons in pieces with prosciutto, sweetbreads and mushrooms, bound with butter and lemon.
Piccioni arrostiti in casseruola col bur: Pigeons roasted in a casserole with butter, or on the spit brushed with oil.

Piccioni cotti al vapore per due ore in: Pigeons steamed for two hours in a closed container over the boiling pot.
Piccioni in casseruola con tartufi, fega: Pigeons in a casserole with truffles, chicken livers, sweetbread, herbs and white wine.
Piccioni in umido con cipolla e prosciut: Pigeons stewed with onion and prosciutto, surrounded by peas cooked in their sauce.

Piccola pasta ripiena di stracotto e sal: Small pasta filled with slow-braised beef and salami, served in capon broth. Small and delicate, they are served in hot broth: the festive first course of Mantua.
Piccole lumache di mare dell'Alto Adriat: Small sea snails of the northern Adriatic stewed with tomato, to be picked out with a cocktail stick and served with crostini or polenta.
Piccole ricotte intere, impanate con pan: Small whole ricottas, coated in herb breadcrumbs and baked on a bed of leeks and carrots.
Piccole ricotte sode passate più volte n: Small firm ricottas rolled several times in sugar, then in flour and egg, fried and dusted with cinnamon: a hot sweet of the Neapolitan home.
Piccoli cavoli farciti di vitello, ricot: Small cabbages stuffed with veal, ricotta and marjoram, cooked in broth on bread.
Piccoli fagioli dal colore variabile, le: Small beans of varying colour, boiled and dressed with new oil. Delicate and thin-skinned: they are served warm as a side dish.
Piccoli flan di spinaci, ricotta e parmi: Little flans of spinach, ricotta and Parmigiano, steamed and served with a Fontina fonduta.
Piccoli pancake di fiocchi d'avena e mir: Small oat and blueberry pancakes stacked in towers, with sweetened ricotta and strawberries between the layers.
Piccoli pani tondi cotti negli stampi, d: Small round breads cooked in moulds, to be filled with Modena-style lard pesto. They are split open while still hot and filled; they are eaten with cured meats and cheeses.
Piccoli sformati di orzo mantecato con a: Small timbales of barley finished with asiago and chives, served on a sauce of red radicchio and cream.
Piedi di vitello lessati due ore col les: Calf's feet boiled for two hours with the boiled meat, boned and dressed as a salad.
Piedini e cotenne di maiale lessati con: Pig's trotters and rinds boiled with onion, cloves and garlic.

Piramide scenografica di pesce, crostace: A spectacular pyramid of fish, shellfish and vegetables on ship's biscuits, with green sauce. It is made for Christmas Eve and brought to the table whole, like a cake.
Piselli freschi al battuto di prosciutto: Fresh peas with a battuto of prosciutto, bound with eggs and parmesan, cooked in a bain-marie.
Piselli freschi al burro e prezzemolo co: Fresh peas with butter and parsley, with chicken combs, livers and testicles.
Piselli freschi cotti col battuto di pro: Fresh peas cooked with a battuto of prosciutto, puréed and poured over fried bread.
Piselli freschi in tegame con un battuto: Fresh peas in a pan with a battuto of pancetta, garlic and parsley.
Piselli freschi stufati coperti con cipo: Fresh peas stewed covered with onion, parsley and oil, served moist.
Piselli mangiatutto lessati e ripassati: Mangetout boiled and finished in a pan with lard and onion.
Piselli novelli stufati con cipollotto e: Young peas stewed with spring onion and prosciutto crudo in strips.
Piselli sgranati lessati in acqua salata: Shelled peas boiled in salted water and dressed with just-melted butter.
Pizza bianca con sugna, ciccioli e origa: A white pizza with sugna, cracklings and oregano, baked in the bread oven.
Pizzette di pasta sfoglia ripiene di pom: Little puff-pastry pizzas filled with tomato, capers and anchovies, browned in the oven: the snack of the Cagliari pastry shops.
Pizzette senza impasto lievitato: brocco: Mini pizzas without a yeast dough: boiled broccoli blended with flour, eggs and Parmigiano, topped with tomato and mozzarella.

Polenta a fette a strati con un sugo di: Sliced polenta in layers with a sauce of sausage, tomato and cheese.
Polenta al latte a losanghe a strati con: Milk polenta in lozenges layered with ragù, béchamel and parmesan, baked in the oven.
Polenta al latte con tuorli, albumi mont: Milk polenta with yolks, whisked whites, pine nuts and raisins, baked in the oven.
Polenta cotta nel brodo e sugo, mescolat: Polenta cooked in broth and sauce, mixed with butter and truffles and turned out of a mould.
Polenta cotta nell'acqua dei cavoli neri: Polenta cooked in the water of cavolo nero, dressed with oil and Parmigiano.
Polenta di grano saraceno e mais arricch: Buckwheat and maize polenta enriched with butter and melted cheese. Dark and rustic, stringy with cheese: it is eaten hot, on its own or with meat and mushrooms.
Polenta di latte a strati con mele e pin: Milk polenta in layers with apples and pine nuts, baked and then browned in pieces.
Polenta di mais Nostrano di Storo servit: Polenta of Storo Nostrano maize served with sautéed mushrooms. Yellow and rustic, it is served hot with the mushrooms on top.
Polenta mantecata con fontina e burro fu: Polenta enriched with Fontina and melted butter, very rich and stringy. Stringy and very rich: it is served piping hot, freshly made.
Polenta morbida con fonduta di formaggio: Soft polenta with a cheese fondue and butter with smoked ricotta. Served piping hot in bowls: polenta, cheese and butter are mixed together with the spoon.
Polenta morbida cotta nel latte, a cucch: Soft polenta cooked in milk, in spoonfuls in a tureen with butter and cheese.
Polenta morbida toscana di farina gialla: A soft Tuscan polenta of yellow maize flour cooked together with cavolo nero, dressed with garlic, oil and parmesan.
Polenta soda a cucchiaiate, a strati con: Spoonfuls of firm polenta, layered with veal sauce and plenty of Parmigiano.
Polenta tenera condita col sugo di manzo: Soft polenta dressed with slow-cooked beef sauce and Parmigiano.
Polentina dolce di semolino e latte con: A sweet semolina and milk porridge with yolks, citron and sultanas, fried in balls.
Pollastra giovane cotta due ore al solo: A young pullet cooked for two hours by steam alone, sealed in with butter and salt.
Pollastra stufata col prosciutto, il suo: A young hen stewed with prosciutto; its juices make a risotto with parmesan.
Pollastri aperti a libro, marinati due o: Spring chickens opened out flat, marinated for two hours in oil and herbs and cooked on the grill.
Pollastri giovani interi allo spiedo, un: Whole young chickens on the spit, brushed with oil and salted, in three quarters of an hour.
Pollastri lessati a metà, poi a pezzi im: Spring chickens half boiled, then cut in pieces, coated in egg and breadcrumbs and fried in lard.

Pollastro in sei pezzi, passato nell'uov: Young chicken in six pieces, dipped in egg and breadcrumbs, cooked covered in butter.

Pollo bollito con le verdure, servito ca: Chicken boiled with vegetables, served hot with boiled potatoes with butter and parsley.
Pollo giovane a pezzi infarinato, passat: Young chicken in pieces, floured, dipped in egg and breadcrumbs, browned in lard.
Pollo impanato e verdure in pastella fri: Breadcrumbed chicken and vegetables in batter, fried: artichokes, courgettes, flowers, potatoes.
Pollo intero rosolato nel burro con gli: A whole chicken browned in butter with aromatics, then stewed with mushrooms and tomato.

Pollo intero rosolato su cipolla e prosc: Whole chicken browned on onion and prosciutto, then stewed with fresh sausages.

Pollo rosolato con prosciutto e rosmarin: Chicken browned with prosciutto and rosemary, then cooked with tomato and potatoes.
Pollo senza ossa ripieno di vitello, pro: A boneless chicken stuffed with veal, prosciutto and tongue, boiled and finished in its sauce.
Pollo stufato nel burro con gli odori, o: Chicken stewed in butter with aromatics, chopped, pounded and whole olives, and tomato.
Polmone di vitello a fettine rosolato ne: Calf's lung in thin slices browned in butter, bound with flour and broth.
Polmone di vitello in umido con pomodoro: Calf's lung stewed with tomato and white wine, served on polenta.
Polmone lessato a dadini, saltato 5 minu: Boiled lung in small cubes, sautéed for 5 minutes over a fierce heat in butter.
Polpa d'aragosta legata con besciamella,: Lobster flesh bound with béchamel, shaped into cutlets, breadcrumbed and fried.
Polpa di albicocche mature passata, scir: Ripe apricot pulp puréed with syrup and lemon, frozen in the ice-cream maker.
Polpa di ananas maturo passata con molto: Ripe pineapple flesh sieved with plenty of lemon and syrup, frozen Genoese-style.
Polpa di aragosta lessa con lattuga, uov: Boiled lobster meat with lettuce, hard-boiled eggs, anchovies, capers and gherkins.
Polpa di banane mature passata con limon: Ripe banana pulp puréed with lemon and syrup, frozen in the ice-cream maker.
Polpa di castagne con tuorli montati, ru: Chestnut purée with whisked yolks, rum and stiff egg whites, dusted with chocolate.
Polpa di pesche mature con sciroppo prof: Ripe peach pulp with a syrup scented with bitter almond and lemon.
Polpa di stoccafisso ammollato sminuzzat: Flaked flesh of soaked stockfish in batter, fried in spoonfuls.
Polpa di zucca al forno lavorata con bur: Oven-baked pumpkin flesh worked with butter, eggs, lemon and almonds, in a cake tin.
Polpette al forno di patate e mandorle,: Baked potato and almond balls, egg-free, coated in cornmeal and served with a raw sauce of spinach, almonds and lemon.
Polpette al forno di sgombro tritato con: Baked balls of minced mackerel with cashews, lemon, garlic, parsley and breadcrumbs, without eggs.
Polpette di alici fresche frullate con p: Balls of fresh anchovies blended with potato, Parmigiano, egg, parsley and lemon zest, breaded and baked.
Polpette di ceci frullati con zucchine,: Chickpea patties blended with courgettes, carrot and onion, bound with chickpea flour and egg and cooked in a little oil.
Polpette di ceci, patate e verdure lessa: Patties of chickpeas, potatoes and boiled vegetables blended with grana and breadcrumbs, baked in the oven.
Polpette di fagioli cannellini schiaccia: Balls of mashed cannellini beans and tuna with anchovies, pecorino and chives, breadcrumbed and browned in the oven.
Polpette di fagioli e piselli con carote: Patties of beans and peas with grated carrots and courgettes, coated in breadcrumbs and sesame and baked in the oven.
Polpette di fegato, lardo e parmigiano n: Balls of liver, lard and Parmigiano in caul fat, cooked with wine and bay.
Polpette di formaggio, uova e pane, frit: Balls of cheese, eggs and bread, fried and then cooked in tomato sauce. Soft and full of cheese: they are served hot, in their sauce.
Polpette di lesso brasato con pinoli e u: Meatballs of braised boiled beef with pine nuts and raisins, breadcrumbed and fried on Shrove Tuesday.
Polpette di patate, uova e parmigiano, i: Croquettes of potato, eggs and Parmigiano, breaded and browned in butter.
Polpette di tonno, ceci frullati e patat: Patties of tuna, blended chickpeas and boiled potato with capers, anchovy and parsley, baked in the oven.
Polpette di trippa, prosciutto e parmigi: Meatballs of tripe, prosciutto and parmesan, fried and finished in tomato.
Polpette di zucca arrosto con parmigiano: Roasted pumpkin balls with Parmigiano and sage, with a cube of scamorza in the middle, baked in the oven.
Polpette di zucca arrosto schiacciata e: Balls of mashed roast squash and goat's ricotta with Parmigiano and sage, baked in the oven.
Polpette di zucchine grattugiate e ricot: Balls of grated courgette and ricotta with Parmigiano and mint, baked in the oven.
Polpette fatte con la carne del bollito: Meatballs made with leftover boiled meat, bread, eggs, parmesan and parsley, fried and, if you like, finished in tomato sauce.
Polpette in bianco di carne e patate les: Plain meatballs of meat and boiled potatoes with Parmigiano and parsley, breaded and baked in the oven.
Polpette milanesi di carne lessa avanzat: Milanese meatballs of leftover boiled meat, mortadella and cheese, fried in butter. Golden and soft: they are eaten hot, also as a starter.
Polpette schiacciate di purè di patate,: Flattened patties of mashed potato, carrots and peas with eggs and parmesan, coated in breadcrumbs and baked in the oven.
Polpette vegetali senza uova: cous cous: Egg-free vegetable patties: couscous and peas blended with parsley, cooked in a pan or in the oven.
Polpette verdi di edamame lessati e frul: Green patties of boiled edamame blended with couscous, ginger and parsley, rolled in sesame seeds and baked.
Polpettine di borragine e cervello di vi: Small borage and veal-brain croquettes fried in oil: delicate and inexpensive.
Polpettine di ceci frullati con basilico: Little balls of blended chickpeas with basil, parsley, seeds and lemon zest, breaded and baked instead of fried.
Polpettine di pollo tritato con uova, pa: Little meatballs of minced chicken with eggs, breadcrumbs and parmesan baked in the oven, served with boiled celery and carrots.
Polpettine di ricotta, uova, pangrattato: Little balls of ricotta, eggs, breadcrumbs and parsley baked in the oven.
Polpettine di semolino al latte con mand: Little patties of semolina cooked in milk with pounded almonds, breaded and fried.
Polpettine di vitello e animelle dorate: Little veal and sweetbread meatballs browned in a pan and served in broth on bread.
Polpettone ligure-genovese alleggerito:: A lightened Ligurian-Genoese polpettone: potatoes, green beans, ricotta, eggs, bread and parmesan, baked in a tin.
Polpettone vegetale di lenticchie, carot: A vegetable loaf of lentils, carrots and onion chopped with breadcrumbs and herbs, rolled up and baked in the oven.
Pomodori cotti a lungo con cipollette e: Tomatoes cooked for a long time with spring onions and roots in lard, then broth and bread.
Pomodori ripieni di pane, cipolla, parmi: Tomatoes filled with bread, onion, Parmigiano, eggs and oregano, baked in a dish.
Porcini a fettine sottili cotti piano co: Porcini in thin slices cooked slowly with oil, garlic and oregano, with fried croutons.
Porcini di media grandezza a fette, infa: Medium-sized porcini in slices, floured and fried in oil.
Porcini piccoli cotti in tegame con olio: Small porcini cooked in a pan with oil, garlic, nepitella and a little tomato.
Porcini tritati cotti nel burro, legati: Chopped porcini cooked in butter, bound with béchamel, eggs and parmesan.
Portare il latte a sobbollire in una pen: Bring the milk to simmer in a large pot.
Portare sul fuoco medio e cuocere mescol: Bring on medium heat and cook stirring continuously with a whisk.
Preriscaldare il forno a 175 °C e imburr: Preheat the oven to 175 °C and butter a 22 cm doughnut mold.
Prugne secche cotte piano nel vino rosso: Prunes cooked gently in red wine and marsala with sugar and cinnamon.
Pulire i pesci, infarinarli e friggerli: Clean the fish, flour them and fry them in hot oil; drain and salt them.
Purea di ceci con uova e parmigiano chiu: Chickpea purée with eggs and parmesan enclosed between two layers of thin potatoes and baked in the oven.
Purea di mele al vino bianco coperta di: Apple purée in white wine covered with whisked egg whites and hazelnuts, browned in the oven.
Purè di fave secche con cicoria selvatic: Purée of dried broad beans with boiled wild chicory and raw oil. A smooth purée with the slight bitterness of chicory: it is served warm with plenty of raw oil.
Purè di lenticchie insaporito con soffri: A lentil purée flavoured with a vegetable soffritto and broth, firm and velvety.
Purè di patate con balsamella, uova e pa: Mashed potato with béchamel, eggs and parmesan, browned in the oven in a tin.
Purè di patate con burro, uova, latte e: Mashed potato with butter, eggs, milk and parsley, cooked in a pan and rolled up.
Purè di patate passate al setaccio con b: Potatoes pushed through a sieve with butter and milk, to garnish boiled meats and stews.
Purè di piselli secchi col soffritto al: A purée of dried peas with a soffritto of butter and tomato, served with croutons.
Purè leggero di cavolfiore e patate frul: A light purée of cauliflower and potatoes blended with Parmigiano, nutmeg and a drizzle of oil, without butter or milk.
Quadretti di cervello e besciamella soda: Squares of brains and firm béchamel, breaded and fried in lard.
Quadretti di pane al burro con foglie di: Squares of buttered bread with parsley leaves and anchovy fillets.
Quadrotti di polenta fritti, street food: Fried squares of polenta, street food of Bari Vecchia. Crisp outside and soft inside: they are eaten hot, freshly fried, with salt.
Quadrotti di purè di patate, burro e tuo: Squares of mashed potato, butter and yolks, coated in egg white and breadcrumbs and fried.
Quaglie al burro e salvia, servite su cr: Quail with butter and sage, served on croutons of bread browned in their juices.
Quaglie rosolate col prosciutto e cotte: Quails browned with prosciutto and cooked together with the rice in broth, with parmesan.
Quarti posteriori di coniglio lardellati: Hindquarters of rabbit larded, basted with butter and roasted.
Quarto di lepre lardellato di prosciutto: A quarter of hare larded with ham, half stewed and finished on the spit.
Quattro creme gialla, bruna, verde e ros: Four creams, yellow, brown, green and red, poured in a pattern into a bowl.
Quattro legumi secchi con soffritto alla: Four dried pulses with a savory soffritto and small macaroni in broth.
Quinoa con carote e cipolla appassite, p: Quinoa with softened carrots and onion, peas, olives, diced feta and semi-dried cherry tomatoes.
Quinoa con edamame, asparagi lessati, sp: Quinoa with edamame, boiled asparagus, baby spinach, rocket and fresh peas, dressed only with oil.
Quinoa con melanzane lunghe e zucchine s: Quinoa with long aubergines and courgettes sautéed with garlic, parsley and mint.
Quinoa ed edamame freddi con noci, semi: Cold quinoa and edamame with walnuts, pumpkin, sunflower, chia and linseeds and goji berries, dressed with soy sauce and oil.
Quinoa lessata e poi tostata in forno fi: Quinoa boiled and then toasted in the oven until crunchy, with roasted asparagus, edamame, avocado and a tahini, lime and ginger dressing.
Quinoa servita su una crema di zucca con: Quinoa served on a squash cream with button mushrooms sautéed with thyme.
Radicchio e finocchi affettati con primo: Sliced radicchio and fennel with primosale, apples, hazelnuts and a dressing of honey, oil and cider vinegar.
Radicchio, lattughino, finocchio a julie: Radicchio, baby lettuce, julienned fennel and orange segments with edamame and balsamic vinegar.
Radicchio, mele e feta a cubetti con cas: Radicchio, apples and diced feta with crumbled cooked chestnuts, dressed with oil and balsamic vinegar.
Radici di scorzonera lessate con un po': Black salsify roots boiled with a little flour and dressed with oil, salt and pepper.
Radici di scorzonera stufate nel soffrit: Salsify roots stewed in a soffritto and bound with yolks and lemon.
Ragù di frattaglie, creste e animelle in: A sweet-and-sour ragù of offal, cockscombs and sweetbreads with Marsala. Rich and dark, it is served hot as a one-dish meal or in a pastry case.
Ramolaccio grattato o a fette sottili, c: Black radish, grated or thinly sliced, dressed with oil, salt and pepper.
Ranocchi cotti col pomodoro e passati, c: Frogs cooked with tomato and sieved, with the legs boned and mushrooms, over bread.
Rape dolci lessate a bastoncini e carame: Sweet turnips boiled in sticks and caramelised in lard with sugar.
Rape inacidite nelle vinacce, stufate e: Turnips soured in grape marc, stewed and served with Friulian cotechino. The sourness of the turnips and the richness of the musetto: a Friulian winter dish.
Ravioli 'panciuti' ripieni di preboggion: «Pot-bellied» ravioli filled with preboggion and herbs, with a creamy walnut sauce. They are served with walnut sauce and a dusting of Parmigiano: a dish of Genoa.
Ravioli a spiga ripieni di patate, pecor: Wheat-ear ravioli filled with potatoes, pecorino, mint and garlic. Closed by hand into the shape of an ear of wheat: they are served with tomato sauce and pecorino.
Ravioli di cappone, cervello, animelle e: Ravioli of capon, brains, sweetbreads and chicken livers with spinach, with butter and cheese.
Ravioli di pasta all'uovo ripieni di ric: Egg-pasta ravioli filled with sheep's ricotta, pecorino and parsley, dressed with tomato and basil sauce.
Ravioli di pasta di semola ripieni di fo: Semolina ravioli filled with fresh sheep's cheese, sugar and lemon zest, boiled and dressed with sugar and cinnamon.
Ravioli di scarola, borragine, salsiccia: Ravioli of escarole, borage, sausage and ricotta, with veal sauce.
Ravioli dolci fritti di Natale ripieni d: Sweet fried Christmas ravioli filled with chickpeas, chestnuts, chocolate and cooked must. Crisp outside and soft inside: they are served at Christmas, dusted with sugar.
Ravioli dolci fritti ripieni di castagne: Sweet fried ravioli filled with chestnuts, chickpeas, chocolate and cooked must. Crisp outside and soft inside: they are served dusted with sugar, at Christmas.
Ravioli fritti di zucca e brussu della V: Fried ravioli of pumpkin and brussu from the Val Nervia. Crisp outside and soft inside: they are eaten hot, as a starter.
Ravioli genovesi di pollo, piccione, vit: Genoese ravioli of chicken, pigeon, veal and borage, with veal sauce.
Ravioli liguri ripieni di zucca e carni: Ligurian ravioli filled with squash and veal, dressed with beef sauce.
Raviolo di frolla ripieno di mostarda bo: A shortcrust raviolo filled with Bolognese mostarda, baked in the oven. Crumbly outside, with a sweet, spiced filling: it is served at the end of the meal.
Ribes e ciliegie scure passati con limon: Redcurrants and dark cherries puréed with lemon and syrup: a red, sharp sorbet.
Ricotta fresca mescolata con zucchero e: Fresh ricotta mixed with sugar and rum, served with slices of bread.
Riempire con il composto stampini a semi: Fill with the mixture half-sphere molds (or pirottini) of 5 cm, buttered and floured, for two thirds.
Ripieno di zucca, amaretti e mostarda di: A filling of squash, amaretti and apple mostarda, with melted butter and grana. A sweet filling, with the heat of the mostarda: it is the Christmas Eve dish in Mantua.
Riso Vialone cotto a vapore nella pentol: Vialone rice steamed in the pot and dressed with salamella sausage. Separate, dry grains, not creamed: it is the risotto of the «piloti», the workers at the rice-husking mills of the Mantua area.
Riso al burro e parmigiano assodato in f: Rice with butter and parmesan set in the oven, served with chicken giblets in a stew.
Riso al sugo con trito di vitello e parm: Rice in sauce with minced veal and Parmigiano, baked into a crust in a dish.
Riso all'onda con piselli novelli, quasi: Rice «all'onda» (loose and wavy) with new peas, almost a soup. It is eaten with a spoon, green and scented with fresh peas: it is the spring dish of Venice.
Riso cotto a lungo nel latte con vanigli: Rice cooked for a long time in milk with vanilla and rum, lightened with the egg whites.
Riso cotto adagio nel latte, con uova, l: Rice cooked slowly in milk, with eggs, lemon, pine nuts and amaretti, baked in the oven.
Riso cotto con bietole, cavolo novello e: Rice cooked with chard, spring cabbage and parsley, finished with garlic pesto.
Riso cotto nel brodo di pollo e legato c: Rice cooked in chicken broth and bound with butter, parmesan and yolks, to go with boiled meat.
Riso cotto nel latte con burro e parmigi: Rice cooked in milk with butter and parmesan, in breaded, fried little cylinders.
Rice cooked in milk with butter and Parmigiano, bound with yolks: a runny risotto.
Riso cotto nel latte con uovo e mele a f: Rice cooked in milk with egg and sliced apples, set in the oven and browned in pieces.
Riso cotto nel latte e legato con parmig: Rice cooked in milk and bound with parmesan and yolks, dropped by spoonfuls into breadcrumbs and fried: the nineteenth-century Neapolitan rice crocchè, without filling.
Riso cotto nel sugo di tinche passate al: Rice cooked in a sauce of tench passed through a sieve, with peas or mushrooms.
Riso cotto nell'acqua, mescolando spesso: Rice cooked in water, stirred often so that it turns creamy without butter, yellow with saffron and scented with lemon, wild fennel and pistachios.
Riso di magro trentino, cotto nell'acqua: Trentino meatless rice, cooked in water on a soffritto of oil, onion and sardines.
Riso e farro cotti insieme come un risot: Rice and spelt cooked together like a risotto with asparagus, finished with butter and cheese and served as little timbales with raw cherry tomatoes.
Riso integrale freddo con ceci, fagioli: Cold brown rice with chickpeas, red kidney beans and peas, pepper, tomatoes and spring onion, dressed with lemon and basil.
Riso nero con ceci, zucchina a dadini, p: Black rice with chickpeas, diced courgette, cherry tomatoes and a lemon and mint dressing.
Riso nero con edamame e gamberetti al va: Black rice with steamed edamame and shrimps, sweetcorn and a lime citronette.
Riso nero integrale con asparagi e pisel: Black brown rice with sautéed asparagus and peas, toasted almonds and lemon zest.
Riso tostato a lungo nel burro con pezze: Rice toasted at length in butter with pieces of aged caciocavallo browned in it, then cooked in broth until it stays dry: neither soup nor risotto, a nineteenth-century Neapolitan first course.
Riso tostato con un soffritto di cipolla: Rice toasted with a soffritto of onion, carrot, celery and leek, cooked in broth.
Riso, farro e orzo freddi con asparagi s: Cold rice, spelt and barley with sautéed asparagus, diced turkey breast, green olives and red onion.
Risotto al burro cotto ad acqua e insapo: A butter risotto cooked with water and flavoured halfway with tomato sauce.
Risotto al burro e cipolla, cotto ad acq: A risotto with butter and onion, cooked with water, finished with peas cooked with carnesecca.
Risotto al fumetto di lago con persico b: A risotto made with lake-fish stock and chopped perch, with a swirl of lemon cream.
Risotto allo zafferano mantecato con bur: Saffron risotto finished with butter and grana, with beef marrow. Golden yellow, creamy and «all'onda» (wavy): it is served on its own or with ossobuco.
Risotto bianco con cipolla, brodo di car: A white risotto with onion, meat broth, butter and Parmigiano, served with shaved white truffle or with roast gravy.
Risotto col brodo dei gamberi di fiume p: Risotto with the broth of pounded crayfish, with the largest crayfish whole.
Risotto colorato con cavolo cappuccio vi: A colourful risotto with purple cabbage stewed with onion, finished with parmesan and raw oil.
Risotto con asparagi a tocchetti, mantec: Risotto with asparagus in small pieces, finished with stracchino and topped with chopped toasted hazelnuts.
Risotto con carote e cipolla, mantecato: Risotto with carrots and onion, finished with crescenza and parmesan instead of butter.
Risotto con fagioli, cotenne e salam d'l: A risotto with beans, pork rind and salam d'la duja. Thick and full of flavour, a rustic winter risotto: it is served hot.
Risotto con le verdure della primavera:: Risotto with spring vegetables: courgettes, asparagus, peas and artichokes.
Risotto con seppie in umido, bietola e i: Risotto with stewed cuttlefish, chard and their ink. Black and creamy, tasting of the sea: it is served at once.
Risotto con vitello tritato, cervello e: A risotto with minced veal, brains and marrow, finished with saffron and Parmigiano.
Risotto cotto nell'acqua delle telline,: Risotto cooked in the water from tellins, with a soffritto of vegetables and dried mushrooms.
Risotto di magro con acciughe salate, fu: A meatless risotto with salted anchovies, dried mushrooms, butter and Parmigiano, without salt.
Risotto di magro con gamberi di fiume, r: A meatless risotto with crayfish, frogs and peas, born at the Certosa di Pavia. Delicate and with the taste of fresh water: it is served hot, just finished.
Risotto di riso integrale con asparagi,: A brown-rice risotto with asparagus, cooked in a broth made on the spot and finished only with raw oil, without butter.
Risotto in bianco con filetti di persico: White risotto with perch fillets browned in butter and sage. The fish stays crisp on top of the creamy rice: it is served at once.
Risotto mantecato col brodo di ghiozzo d: Risotto finished with the broth of lagoon goby, a dish of Burano. Delicate and creamy, full of the flavour of the lagoon: it is served at once, all'onda.
Risotto mantecato col brodo e la polpa d: Risotto made with the broth and flesh of rice-paddy frogs. Delicate and creamy: the risotto of the rice paddies of Pavia and Vercelli.
Risotto mantecato con luganega di Monza: Risotto finished with crumbled Monza luganega sausage. Creamy and full of sausage flavour: it is served at once with Parmesan.
Risotto mantecato con radicchio tardivo: Risotto finished with stewed late radicchio and red wine. Dark red, slightly bitter and creamy: it is made in winter, when the tardivo is in season.
Risotto semplice finito con salsiccia sb: A plain risotto finished with crumbled sausage, tomato and cheese.
Risotto senza burro con la zucca cotta a: A butterless risotto with squash cooked separately, white wine, rosemary and walnut kernels.
Risotto sfumato e cotto con Barolo, mant: A risotto deglazed and cooked with Barolo, finished with butter and Parmigiano. Dark red and fragrant with wine: it is served at once, hot.
Ritagliare i biscotti con l'apposito sta: Cut the cookies with the special six-petal flower mold (or a 6 cm sleek biscuit cutter) and make the hole in the middle with a cap or a small cuppasta.
Ritagliare le pastine con un tagliapasta: Cut the pasta with a round cutter of 5 cm: about 50 of them come.
Ritagliare le sfogliatine con un tagliap: Cut the dough with a round cutter of 5 cm, pressing well around the filling, and put them on the baking tray with baking paper.
Rocchi d'anguilla marinati con olio e li: Chunks of eel marinated with oil and lemon, roasted on the spit with sage.
Rocchi d'anguilla rosolati con aglio, sa: Chunks of eel browned with garlic, sage and lemon, then cooked in wine and tomato.
Rognone a fettine sbollentato, saltato n: Thinly sliced kidney, blanched and sautéed in butter with white wine and parsley.
Rognone di vitello alla griglia a fettin: Grilled calf's kidney in thin slices, in a soft omelette folded in half.
Rognoni a fettine saltati nel burro con: Thinly sliced kidneys sautéed in butter with parsley, garlic and lemon, on toasted bread.
Rognoni di maiale a fettine cotti in un: Pig's kidneys in thin slices cooked in a garlic and parsley soffritto with tomato.
Rognoni di vitello alla graticola servit: Grilled veal kidneys served with a sauce of pounded liver and lemon.
Rognoni di vitello o di maiale marinati: Calf's or pig's kidneys marinated in oil, garlic and pepper and cooked over embers.
Rombi di pasta fritta gonfi e cavi, da m: Diamonds of fried dough, puffed and hollow, to eat with cured meats. Hot and light, they are eaten at once with prosciutto, salami and coppa.
Rondelle di zucchina saltate a fuoco viv: Courgette rounds sautéed over a fierce heat in oil and scented with oregano.
Rose di sfoglia fritta inzuppate nel vin: Roses of fried pastry soaked in vincotto or honey. Crisp and glossy with vincotto: they are eaten at Christmas in Puglia.
Rose di sfoglia ripiene di noci, uvetta: Pastry roses filled with walnuts, raisins and honey, baked in a tin. It is served at room temperature, in slices: the festive sweet of San Giovanni in Fiore.
Rosolare cipolla e lardo nel burro chiar: Sauté onion and lard in clarified butter and oil with sage and rosemary.
Rosolare dolcemente le cipolle affettate: Sauté the sliced onions in the rest of the butter gently.
Rosolare i fegatini con una piccola part: Brown the livers with a small portion of garlic, onion, sage and rosemary.
Rosolare il cosciotto di capra con carot: Sauté the goat's leg with carrot, celery and chopped onion, cover with water and cook slowly; add sauce and peel and finish cooking the sauce.
Rosolare il guanciale a listarelle, togl: Sauté the pillow in strips, remove it and fry onion and zucchini in the remaining fat.
Sauté the lard in a pan.
Rosolare il pezzente con olio e aglio, s: Sauté the piece with oil and garlic, deglaze with the white wine and add the tomato sauce.
Rosolare il trito in casseruola con la c: Sauté the chopped casserole with the minced meat over low heat, stirring often.
Rosolare in padella con un filo d'olio l: Sauté the crumbled sausages in a frying pan with a little oil.
Rosolare l'aglio in 4 cucchiai d'olio, t: Sauté the garlic in 4 tablespoons of oil, remove and add the tomatoes, salt and chilli.
Sauté the garlic in three tablespoons of oil.
Rosolare l'aglio nell'olio, unire il cap: Brown the garlic in the oil, add the kid and brown it.
Rosolare l'altro spicchio d'aglio nell'o: Sauté the other clove of garlic in the oil in a pan and remove it.
Rosolare l'oca con l'olio su tutti i lat: Sauté the goose with oil on all sides.
Rosolare la carne di cinghiale a cubetti: Sauté the meat of wild boar in cubes and deglaze with the red wine.
Rosolare la carne nell'olio e scaldare a: Sauté the meat in the oil and heat aside the tomato sauce.
Sauté the sliced onion in butter.
Rosolare la cipolla tritata con olio e p: Sauté the chopped onion with oil and chilli.
Rosolare la cipollina nell'olio, unire l: Sauté the chives in the oil, add the remaining grouper in pieces, the tomatoes, the wine, parsley, capers and chilli; add some cooking water and narrow.
Rosolare la pancetta a listarelle e vers: Sauté the bacon in strips and pour it hot on the cabbage.
Rosolare la pasta di lucanica sbriciolat: Sauté the crumbled lucanica paste and place it on the bottom of the bowls.
Rosolare la salsiccetta sbriciolata e te: Sauté the crumbled sausage and keep it aside.
Sauté the meat into small pieces.
Rosolare le cipolline nell'olio in casse: Sauté the onions in the oil in casserole.
Rosolare le verdure nell'olio in una pen: Sauté the vegetables in the oil in a high pot, then add the potatoes to pieces and the meat.
Rosolare metà del battuto di sedano, car: Sauté half of the chopped celery, carrot and onion in the oil and cook the vegetables.

Spicchi di carciofo infarinati, rosolati: Wedges of artichoke floured, browned with garlic and nepitella and finished with tomato.
Spicchi di carciofo stufati nel burro e: Artichoke wedges stewed in butter and bound with yolks, lemon and Parmigiano.
Spicchi di cavolfiore lessati e ripassat: Cauliflower wedges boiled and tossed with anchovies, meat sauce and capers.
Spicchi di cavolo cappuccio scottati e c: Wedges of white cabbage scalded and cooked slowly in a sauce of prosciutto and onion.
Spicchi di finocchio lessati, infarinati: Wedges of fennel boiled, floured and fried in a light batter.
Spicchi di finocchio scottati, cotti nel: Fennel wedges blanched, cooked in butter and broth and finished with parmesan.
Spicchi di mela cotogna cotti nello scir: Wedges of quince cooked in syrup and served cold in their reduced juice.
Spicchi di pesca con la buccia fritti in: Wedges of unpeeled peach fried in batter and covered with sugar.
Spiedini di carne di pecora cotti sulla: Skewers of mutton cooked on the «canala» over embers. Small cubes of meat and fat, full of the flavour of the embers: they are eaten by the dozen, with bread and oil.
Spiedini di vitello, fegato, animelle, c: Skewers of veal, liver, sweetbreads, artichoke and sage, breaded and fried.
Spinaci al magro con pinoli rosolati, ag: Meatless spinach with browned pine nuts, garlic and raisins, served with fried croutons.
Spinaci col soffritto di funghi e pinoli: Spinach with a soffritto of mushrooms and pine nuts in broth, on fried bread and yolks.
Spinaci cotti adagio nel burro con farin: Spinach cooked slowly in butter with flour and cream, creamy, to garnish boiled meats.
Spinaci lessati e ripassati nel burro, c: Spinach boiled and tossed in butter, enclosed in a four-egg omelette.
Spinaci lessati e tritati fini, insapori: Spinach boiled and finely chopped, flavoured in butter with a little cream and parmesan.
Spinaci lessati, tritati grossi e ripass: Spinach boiled, roughly chopped and tossed with garlic, oil and a little pepper.
Spinaci nel burro legati con uova, parmi: Spinach in butter bound with eggs, Parmigiano and marjoram, served with croutons.
Spinaci passati con besciamella, uova, c: Sieved spinach with béchamel, eggs, cinnamon and raisins, filled with giblets.
Spinaci ripassati nel burro con pinoli e: Spinach tossed in butter with pine nuts and raisins, a Genoese side for boiled meats and eggs.
Spirale di pasta lievitata ripiena di no: A spiral of leavened dough filled with walnuts, raisins, pine nuts and grappa. It is served in slices, often soaked with grappa or slivovitz: it is the festive cake of Friuli.
Stampini foderati di sarde aperte a libr: Small moulds lined with butterflied sardines and filled with barley, courgette and carrot, baked and served on a tomato sauce.
Starne arrostite nella carta con cipolla: Grey partridges roasted in paper with onion, bay and oil, basted with their own fat.
Stecchini di fegatini, groviera e lingua: Skewers of chicken livers, gruyère and tongue coated in béchamel, breadcrumbed and fried.
Stecchini freschi che alternano cubetti: Fresh skewers alternating cubes of melon, primosale and cucumber with basil leaves: sweet and savoury together.

Stendere due terzi della frolla a 4 mm e: Roll out two-thirds of the 4 mm short and cover a 22 cm buttered cake tin.
Stendere due terzi della frolla e fodera: Roll out two thirds of the short and cover a pan of 24 cm.
Stendere due terzi della frolla in una t: Spread two thirds of the shorts in a 22 cm baking pan, pierce them and spread the apricot jam.
Stendere la frolla in una teglia di circ: Spread the shorts in a pan of about 24 cm.
Stendere la frolla in uno stampo da 22 c: Spread the shorts in a 22 cm mold and pierce them.
Stendere la pasta reale a 1 cm e foderar: Roll out the royal dough to 1 cm and cover in half a lamb shaped mold (or shape by hand two half of 20 cm lying lamb).
Stenderla alta mezzo centimetro in uno s: Spread it half an inch high in a 24 cm tart mold, pierce the bottom, cover with baking paper and dried legumes.
Stiacciata di manzo e prosciutto tritati: A flat patty of minced beef and prosciutto, cooked in a pan with rosemary and tomato.
Stinco di vitello brasato, con gremolada: Braised veal shank, with a gremolada of lemon, garlic and parsley. It is served with risotto alla milanese; the marrow is eaten with a teaspoon.
Stoccafisso ammollato e cotto adagio in: Stockfish soaked and cooked slowly in a pan with oil, garlic and pepper.
Stoccafisso ammollato, lessato e condito: Soaked stockfish, boiled and dressed with oil, lemon, salt and pepper.
Stoccafisso con patate, olive, capperi e: Stockfish with potatoes, olives, capers and chilli, a speciality of Mammola. Savoury and a little hot: it is served hot, with its sauce.
Stoccafisso cotto lentamente con patate,: Stockfish cooked slowly with potatoes, tomato, olives and Verdicchio. Tender and full of flavour, it is served hot with its sauce.
Stoccafisso lessato e montato con olio f: Stockfish boiled and beaten with oil into a cream, on toasted polenta. White and fluffy, it is spread on polenta crostini: an antipasto of the Venetian bàcari (wine bars).
Stoccafisso stufato con acciughe, aglio,: Stockfish stewed with anchovies, garlic, pine nuts, spices and white wine.
Stoccafisso stufato con bietole, soffrit: Stockfish stewed with chard, an aromatic soffritto and tomato, Genoese-style.
Stoccafisso stufato tre ore in olio, agl: Stockfish stewed for three hours in oil, garlic, parsley and tomato, with potatoes.
Strati di acciughe fresche e patate al f: Layers of fresh anchovies and potatoes baked with garlic, parsley and tomato. It is served hot, in the pan, with bread for the sauce.
Strati di aringhe dissalate nel latte e: Layers of herrings desalted in milk and boiled potatoes, with garlic, cheese and tomato.
Strati di fettine di vitello al parmigia: Layers of thin veal slices with parmesan cooked on lard, served on spinach.
Strati di melanzane fritte, sugo di pomo: Layers of fried aubergines, tomato sauce, fiordilatte, basil and Parmigiano. It is served warm or at room temperature, in squares: it is better the next day.
Strati di patate, tartufo e parmigiano a: Layers of potatoes, truffle and parmesan in butter, moistened with broth and lemon.
Strati di scrippelle (crespelle) con pol: Layers of scrippelle (crêpes) with little meatballs, mozzarella, artichokes and ragù. Tall and rich, it is served hot in slices: it is the festive dish of Teramo.
Strati di sfoglia, zucchine, carote e ci: Layers of pasta sheets, sautéed courgettes, carrots and onion, béchamel with nutmeg, Parmigiano and scamorza.
Strisce di pasta lievitata fritte e serv: Strips of leavened dough fried and served hot with zabaione: the Carnival sweet of the Val Polcevera.
Strisce di trota e lavarello fritte in t: Strips of trout and lavaret fried in three flours, with orange mayonnaise.
Strisce di zucca secca cotte nel brodo c: Strips of dried squash cooked in broth with tripe, sausage, mushrooms and cardoons.
Striscioline di carota passate in farina: Thin strips of carrot coated in flour and breadcrumbs and browned in a pan, served with rocket.
Striscioline di petto di pollo alla pias: Strips of griddled chicken breast with blanched agretti, carrots, celery and olives, dressed with oil and lemon.
Striscioline di seppia saltate a fuoco v: Strips of cuttlefish stir-fried over a high heat with artichokes, mushrooms, fennel, carrots and tomatoes, deglazed with vinegar and sugar and finished with capers and almonds.
Strudel salato marchigiano: sfoglia sott: A savoury Marche strudel: very thin pastry rolled around wild greens sautéed with garlic and baked.
Stufato invernale di tagli poveri di mai: A winter stew of humble cuts of pork and Savoy cabbage, served with polenta. Thick and full of flavour, slow-cooked: it is the Milanese winter dish, when the cabbage has been touched by frost.
Su un piano cosparso di zucchero a velo: On a plane sprinkled with powdered sugar form a cord of 4 cm of diameter and cut it into pieces of 2 cm.
Succo di visciole alla cannella gelato,: Frozen sour-cherry juice with cinnamon, with sour cherries in syrup stirred in.
Sugo di pomodoro cotto lentissimo con gr: Tomato sauce cooked very slowly with large pieces of meat and braciole. Dark and thick after hours of cooking: the sauce dresses the pasta, the meat is the Sunday main course.
Tacchino arrosto al forno col burro, rip: Roast turkey in the oven with butter, stuffed with chestnuts, sausage and chicken livers.
Tacchino con cipolle e garofani, coperto: Turkey with onions and cloves, covered with lard and lemon and roasted in paper.
Tacchino cucito in un telo con macis, li: Turkey sewn into a cloth with mace, lemon and ham, poached in wine and served cold.
Tagliare a dadini i pomodori datterini e: Cut the cherry tomatoes into cubes and sauté them in another pan with garlic, oil and chilli.
Tagliare a metà per traverso le mandorle: Cut in half through the peeled sweet almonds and dry 10 minutes in the oven at 100 °C.
Tagliare il pane a fette sottili e tosta: Cut the bread into thin slices and toast slightly in the oven or frying pan.
Tagliare il pane in cassetta a rombi, to: Cut the bread into diamond boxes, toast and spread the filling over and under.
Tagliare il pane integrale a fette e tos: Slice the wholemeal bread and toast it in the oven or on the griddle for 4-5 minutes.
Tagliare l'agnello a pezzetti e rosolarl: Cut the lamb into small pieces and brown it in oil.
Tagliare la carne a cubetti di 3-4 cm e: Cut the meat into 3-4 cm cubes and brown from all sides.
Tagliare sottile la cipolla e rosolarla: Cut the onion thinly and brown gently in the butter, then remove it.
Tagliare zucchine e melanzane a listarel: Cut zucchini and eggplant into strips and fry them in hot extra virgin olive oil, then dry them on absorbent paper.
Tagliatelle all'uovo con asparagi al bur: Egg tagliatelle with asparagus in butter, morels stewed for a long time with shallot and flakes of hard-boiled egg.
Tagliatelle all'uovo con asparagi sbolle: Egg tagliatelle with asparagus blanched and then sautéed with shallot, bound with grana and cooking water.
Tagliatelle all'uovo con ragù di manzo e: Egg tagliatelle with a long-cooked ragù of beef and pancetta. The long-cooked, thick ragù coats the rough tagliatelle: they are served with grated parmesan.
Tagliatelle corte di semola fatte in cas: Short home-made semolina tagliatelle cooked with boiled chickpeas, garlic, bay leaf and chilli.
Tagliatelle di grano saraceno con patate: Buckwheat tagliatelle with potatoes, Savoy cabbage, garlic butter and Casera cheese. A hearty mountain dish, buttery and stringy: it is served piping hot, freshly made.
Tagliatelle lunghe all'uovo con sugo di: Long egg tagliatelle with a garlic tomato sauce, butter and parmesan.
Tagliatelle lunghe impastate con gli spi: Long tagliatelle made with spinach in the dough, dressed simply with butter and cheese.
Taglierini all'uovo fatti in casa condit: Homemade egg taglierini dressed with stewed beef sauce and Parmigiano.
Homemade egg taglierini dressed with garlic and basil pesto and Parmigiano.
Taglierini all'uovo rivoltati nel piatto: Egg taglierini tossed on a hot dish with fresh butter and plenty of Parmigiano.
Taglierini impastati con borragine, parm: Taglierini kneaded with borage, Parmigiano and sausage, dressed with veal sauce.
Taglierini sottili di pasta all'uovo fat: Thin taglierini of home-made egg pasta, cooked in meat broth.
Taglierini sottili di semola e uova cott: Thin taglierini of semolina and eggs cooked in a clear beef broth.
Tagliolini cotti nel brodo di ossa di ma: Tagliolini cooked in pork-bone broth and finished in a baking tin in layers with lard, pecorino and breadcrumbs, until the broth is absorbed and they turn crisp.
Tagliolini di semola, acqua e sale con f: Thin noodles of semolina, water and salt with beans: «poor man's meat». Simple and nourishing: it is eaten hot, in bowls.
Tagliolini sottili ai tuorli con burro,: Thin egg-yolk tagliolini with butter, Parmigiano and shaved white truffle. Very thin yellow pasta, barely dressed: the star is the scent of autumn truffle.
Tarallo dolce glassato con zucchero e al: A sweet tarallo glazed with sugar and egg white. White and glossy with icing, it is served at the end of the meal.
Teglia a strati di patate, riso crudo, c: A layered bake of potatoes, raw rice, opened mussels, tomato and pecorino. It is served warm, in the dish: a typical dish of Bari.
Telline sgusciate nel soffritto d'odori: Shelled tellins in a soffritto of aromatics and dried mushrooms, with their water, over bread.

Keep the broth warm on minimum heat; heat Amarone in a saucepan, without boiling it.
Testina d'agnello tagliata per lungo e s: Lamb's head split lengthways and stewed with garlic, parsley and tomato.
Timballo di anelletti con ragù, piselli,: A timbale of anelletti with ragù, peas, aubergines and caciocavallo. It is served in slices, warm: a festive dish in Palermo.
Tinca a pezzi rosolata con cipolle e odo: Tench in pieces browned with onions and aromatics, stewed and finished with tomato, with polenta.
Tinche dorate in olio con erbe e aglio,: Tench browned in oil with herbs and garlic, dusted with flour and moistened with white wine.
Tinche intere cotte nel sugo delle loro: Whole tench cooked in a sauce made from their heads with tomato, with flavoured chard.

Tocchetti di polenta soda a strati con b: Chunks of firm polenta in layers with butter, tomato and parmesan.
Tocchi di baccalà grosso arrostiti sulla: Chunks of thick salt cod roasted over embers, brushed with oil, with lemon and pepper.
Tocchi di baccalà marinati in olio e lim: Chunks of salt cod marinated in oil and lemon and roasted in a dish in the oven.

Tondi di pasta ripieni di brasato, salam: Rounds of pasta filled with braised beef, salami and grana, cooked in the three-meat broth. They are served in hot broth, with grated grana: the festive first course of Cremona.
Tondi di petto di pollo battuti, infilat: Rounds of beaten chicken breast, threaded on a stick, breaded and fried in butter.
Tonno marinato due ore con olio, erbe, g: Tuna marinated for two hours with oil, herbs, clove and lemon, then roasted coated in breadcrumbs.
Torta a sfoglie sottili all'olio con spi: A pie of thin oiled pastry layers with spinach tossed in butter and Parmigiano.
Torta a sfoglie sottili all'olio ripiena: A pie of thin oiled pastry layers filled with onions, dried mushrooms and Parmigiano.
A pie of thin oiled pastry layers filled with mushrooms sautéed with garlic and oregano.
Torta a strati di tagliolini sottili, ma: A layered cake of thin tagliolini, almonds, sugar and butter, soaked with rosolio.
Torta al cioccolato fondente con crostic: A dark chocolate cake with a thin crust and a creamy heart. Low, with a thin crust and an almost raw interior: it is served with icing sugar.
Torta alta di farina di riso, nocciole e: A tall cake of rice flour, hazelnuts and almonds, scented with vanilla.
Torta bassa di farina di castagne con pi: A low cake of chestnut flour with pine nuts, raisins, walnuts and rosemary. Moist and dark, barely sweet (there is no sugar): it is served at room temperature, in autumn.
Torta chiusa di pasta di semola e strutt: A closed pie of semolina and strutto pastry filled with eels or lamb with potatoes, garlic and parsley, baked for a long time.
Torta di carote grattugiate con olio ext: A grated carrot cake with extra virgin olive oil and lemon, without butter.
Torta di mele senza glutine, con farina: A gluten-free apple cake, with rice flour, potato starch, brown sugar and seed oil.
Torta di pasta frolla ripiena di carne t: A shortcrust pie filled with minced meat, chocolate, pine nuts, raisins and candied citron.
Torta di riso cotto nel latte, mandorle: A cake of rice cooked in milk, almonds and citron, soaked with liqueur. Dense and moist, it is served cold in small squares, often speared on a cocktail stick.
Torta di uova, zucchero, farina e burro: A cake of eggs, sugar, flour and butter in equal weight, with almonds and lemon.
Torta friabile di farina di mais, mandor: A crumbly cake of maize flour, almonds and lard, to be broken with the hands. It is broken into pieces by hand and served at the end of the meal, perhaps with a sweet wine.
Torta friabile di mandorle sbriciolata,: A crumbly crumbled almond cake, to be broken with the hands. Crumbly and scented with almonds, it is served in pieces with coffee.
Torta genovese soffice di farina di riso: A soft Genoese cake of rice flour, whipped butter, eggs and lemon.
Torta lievitata ripiena di scarola, oliv: A yeasted pie filled with escarole, olives, capers, pine nuts and raisins. It is eaten at room temperature, in slices, the next day too.
Torta rustica di patate e cipolle in teg: A rustic potato and onion pie baked in a tin, without eggs. Low and golden, it is eaten warm or cold, in squares.
Torta rustica pasquale piena di uova, fo: A rustic Easter pie full of eggs, cheeses and cured meats. Tall and very rich, it is eaten in slices, at room temperature, at Easter and on Easter Monday.
Torta salata con base brisée, porri stuf: A savoury tart with a shortcrust base, stewed leeks and slices of boiled potato, bound with egg, milk and Parmigiano.
Torta salata con base brisée, ripieno di: A savoury tart with a shortcrust base, a filling of eggs and ricotta and whole asparagus laid on top like the spokes of a wheel.
Torta salata di bietole e Parmigiano, co: A savoury pie of chard and Parmigiano, with thin pastry and pancetta. It is eaten warm or cold, in squares, also as a snack.
Torta salata di farro IGP, ricotta e par: A savoury tart of IGP spelt, ricotta and parmesan in a shortcrust (brisée) case.
Torta salata di riso, bietole e pecorino: A savoury pie of rice, chard and pecorino, heavily peppered, in thin pastry.
Torta salata sottile ripiena di erbe di: A thin savoury pie filled with wild greens, chard, eggs and cheese. It is eaten warm or cold, in slices, also the next day.
Torta senza burro con farina di grano sa: A cake without butter with buckwheat and almond flour, grated carrots and stiff egg whites, under a sugar icing.
Torta senza farina di noci pestate, cioc: A flourless cake of pounded walnuts, chocolate, whisked eggs and candied citron.
Torta soffice con banane a pezzetti, yog: A soft cake with chopped bananas, yogurt, seed oil and chocolate chips.
Torta soffice con i mandarini frullati i: A soft cake with whole mandarins blended into the batter, seed oil and milk.
Torta soffice di albumi montati, burro e: A soft cake of whisked egg whites, butter and raisins, so as not to waste the whites.
Torta soffice di casa con yogurt, olio e: A soft homemade cake with yogurt, extra virgin olive oil and lemon zest.
Torta soffice di fecola, burro e uova mo: A soft cake of potato starch, butter and whisked eggs, scented with lemon.
Torta soffice di mandorle pestate e molt: A soft cake of pounded almonds and many eggs, with an old Tuscan name.
Torta soffice di sole uova, zucchero e f: A soft cake of just eggs, sugar and flour, scented with lemon.
Torta soffice senza burro, con carote gr: A soft cake without butter, with grated carrots, ground almonds, whisked eggs and lemon zest.
Torta sottile di farina di ceci, acqua e: A thin pancake of chickpea flour, water and oil baked in a wood-fired oven. Crisp on top and soft inside, it is eaten hot in wedges, with black pepper.
Torta umida con nocciola Piemonte IGP to: A moist cake with toasted, ground Nocciola Piemonte PGI hazelnuts. Fragrant and crumbly, it is served in slices, also with zabaione.
Torta umida senza farina e senza burro:: A moist cake without flour or butter: aubergines cooked and blended with dark chocolate give softness, and cannot be tasted.
Torta veneta friabile di farina, farina: A crumbly Venetian cake of flour, maize flour, almonds, butter and sugar, broken up by hand.
Tortellini ripieni di lombata di maiale,: Tortellini filled with pork loin, brains and bone marrow, cooked in broth.
Tortellini ripieni di piccione lesso, pr: Tortellini filled with boiled pigeon, prosciutto and parmesan, with butter.
Tortina di frolla allo strutto ripiena d: A little shortcrust pie made with strutto and filled with pastry cream, served warm. It is eaten warm, at breakfast, with coffee.
Tortine aperte di frolla con visciole co: Open shortcrust tartlets with sour cherries cooked in syrup, the Genoese way.
Tortine di frolla all'arancia ripiene di: Little orange shortcrust tarts filled with almond paste and candied orange.
Tortine di frolla con crema pasticcera e: Little shortcrust pies with pastry cream and sour cherries. Crumbly and creamy inside: they are served at room temperature, dusted with sugar.
Tortine di riso stracotto nel latte con: Little cakes of rice cooked to a mush in milk with candied fruit and rum, puffed and golden.
Tortine di semolino cotto nel latte con: Little cakes of semolina cooked in milk with pine nuts and lemon, baked in small moulds.
Tortine salate senza glutine, con farina: Gluten-free savoury little cakes, with rice flour, blanched asparagus, smoked scamorza and Parmigiano: to serve warm.
Tortine salate senza uova, latte e gluti: Savoury little cakes without eggs, milk or gluten, with rice flour, grated courgettes, black olives, turmeric and flaked almonds.
Tortini di broccoli tritati crudi con uo: Little cakes of raw chopped broccoli with eggs, Parmigiano, breadcrumbs and oil, baked in paper cases.
Tortino di Montasio, patate e cipolla co: A tortino of Montasio, potatoes and onion cooked in a frying pan until it has a golden crust. Crisp outside and soft inside, it is served hot in wedges, often with polenta.
Tortino di frolla ripieno di cioccolato,: A little shortcrust pie filled with chocolate, almonds and cinnamon. Crumbly outside and soft inside: it is served at room temperature.
Tortino di patate schiacciate con stracc: A mashed potato bake with stracchino, eggs, Parmigiano and marjoram, cooked in the oven.
Tortino freddo di tonno, crema di cannel: A cold timbale of tuna, cannellini cream with mustard and black chickpeas of the Murgia, with a prawn on top.

Totani farciti coi loro tentacoli, pangr: Flying squid stuffed with their tentacles, breadcrumbs, parsley and garlic, on the grill.

Tranci di luccio senza lische, impanati: Boneless steaks of pike, breaded and browned in oil and butter.

Tranci di salmone cotti in padella senza: Salmon steaks cooked in a pan without fat, served on a cream of grated courgettes with thyme.

Trancio di storione lardellato, rosolato: A steak of sturgeon larded, browned in oil and butter and stewed, finished with lemon.
Trancio di tonno o dentice rosolato e fi: A steak of tuna or dentex browned and finished in a thick sauce of tomato and aromatics.

Triglie con aglio e rosmarino, marinate: Red mullet with garlic and rosemary, marinated in oil, breadcrumbed and cooked on the grill.

Trippa a strisce saltata con aglio e pre: Tripe in strips tossed with garlic and parsley, bound with eggs and lemon.

Trippa di vitello a listarelle rosolata: Calf's tripe in strips browned in lard, with tomato and polenta.

Trippa in umido con fagioli bianchi, ver: Tripe stewed with white beans, vegetables and tomato. Thick and warming, it is served in winter with grated Parmesan.

Tritare la cipolla e rosolarla nel burro: Chop the onion and brown it in butter.
Tritare la cipolla e stufarla in tegame: Chop the onion and stew it in pan with oil and garlic over moderate heat.

Trofie condite con funghi porcini cotti: Trofie dressed with porcini cooked with garlic, parsley, pine nuts, marjoram and a little tomato.

Tuorlo montato con lo zucchero e albume: Yolk whisked with sugar and white whisked to snow, to dip slices of bread in.
Un soffice pane di uova cotto in forno,: A soft egg bread baked in the oven, cut into cubes and served in broth.

Uova cotte nel burro in un piattino da f: Eggs cooked in butter in a small flameproof dish, with the yolk whole and soft.

Uova fritte nel burro dorato e girate co: Eggs fried in golden butter and turned with the slotted spoon, well browned.

Uova sgusciate nell'acqua bollente con l: Eggs broken into boiling water with vinegar, dressed with butter and parmesan.
Uova sode farcite di tuorli, acciughe, p: Hard-boiled eggs stuffed with yolks, anchovies, parsley and butter, under mayonnaise.

Uova sode tagliate a metà e riempite con: Hard-boiled eggs halved and filled with a paste of yolks, vinegar-soaked bread, mint, parsley, sugar, cinnamon and candied citron, covered with the same cream thinned in vinegar: a cold sweet-and-sour starter.
Uova sode tinte con le bucce di cipolla: Hard-boiled eggs dyed with onion skins and decorated with small parsley leaves.
Uova strapazzate nel burro con la panna,: Eggs scrambled in butter with cream, served on croûtes with parmesan.

Valeriana con ceci, cimette di broccolo: Lamb's lettuce with chickpeas, raw broccoli florets, diced oranges, walnuts and pomegranate, dressed with orange juice and oil.
Vellutata di asparagi e patate con mazza: A velouté of asparagus and potatoes with sautéed king prawns, caramelised cherry tomatoes, dots of ricotta and taralli crumbs.
Vellutata di asparagi, spinaci e mela ve: A velouté of asparagus, spinach and green apple, scented with paprika.
Vellutata di gambi di asparagi e patata,: A velouté of asparagus stalks and potato, served with the tips sautéed in butter and bread croûtons.
Vellutata di patate e piselli in cui si: A velouté of potatoes and peas into which boiled barley, spelt, cannellini, borlotti and chickpeas are mixed.
Vellutata di zucca e cavolini di Bruxell: A velouté of pumpkin and Brussels sprouts, served with browned sprouts and toasted almonds.
Vellutata verde di fave fresche e aspara: A green velouté of fresh broad beans and asparagus with leek, shallot and thyme.
Verdure crude a bastoncini da intingere: Raw vegetable sticks to dip into a sauce of boiled carrots blended with Greek yogurt and mint.
Verdure di campo ripassate servite con l: Sautéed field greens served with crumbled maize bread. Rustic and savoury: it is served hot, on the plate or in the pan.
Verdure di stagione lessate e condite co: Seasonal vegetables boiled and dressed with oil, vinegar and salt, Genoese-style.

Verza lessata e stufata in olio e burro: Savoy cabbage boiled and stewed in oil and butter with parsley and pounded sardines.
Verza tritata, cotta nel burro e latte e: Chopped Savoy cabbage, cooked in butter and milk and bound with béchamel and Parmigiano.
Visciole sciroppate alla cannella a stra: Sour cherries in cinnamon syrup layered with savoiardi moistened with rosolio.
Vitello di latte rosolato su pancetta, b: Milk-fed veal browned on pancetta, butter and lemon, then cooked gently in milk.
Vitello rosolato in casseruola e cotto a: Veal browned in a casserole and cooked slowly with garlic and rosemary, tender and delicate.
Vitello rosolato nel burro e cotto al fo: Veal browned in butter and cooked in the oven, moistened five times with milk.
Vitello stracotto con carnesecca e odori: Veal braised with carnesecca and aromatics: the sauce dresses the maccheroni, the meat is served afterwards.
Vitello, maiale, pollo e lingua a dadi i: Veal, pork, chicken and tongue in cubes in pastry, with a truffle stuffing.
Würstel di maiale scaldati in acqua fino: Pork frankfurters heated in water until it first comes to the boil, served hot at the table.
Zabaione di tuorli, zucchero e vino liqu: A zabaione of yolks, sugar and fortified wine, cooked, cooled and frozen.
Zampa di vitello lessata, disossata e ri: Calf's foot boiled, boned and finished in butter with tomato and parmesan.
Zampetti disossati in umido con cipollot: Boned trotters stewed with spring onions and tomato, bound with yolks and cinnamon.
Zampone di Modena lessato servito con le: Boiled Modena zampone served with stewed lentils: the New Year's dish. It is served hot, in slices, on top of the lentils: they bring luck for the new year.
Ziti spezzati con sugo di cipolle stufat: Broken ziti with a sauce of onions stewed for hours with beef. The onions melt into a sweet, amber sauce: the meat is served afterwards, as a main course.
Zucca barucca a grossi pezzi con la bucc: Barucca pumpkin in large pieces with the skin, baked in the oven and dressed as a salad.
Zucca cotta nel latte con mandorle e can: Pumpkin cooked in milk with almonds and cinnamon, in a tin on a thin layer of pasta matta.
Zucca lessa passata e allungata col latt: Boiled pumpkin, sieved and thinned with milk and butter, with toasted bread.
Zucca lessata e pestata con funghi, pres: Squash boiled and mashed with mushrooms, prescinseua, Parmigiano and oregano, baked in the oven.
Zucca passata e legata con burro e farin: Pumpkin sieved and bound with butter and flour in broth, poured over fried bread.
Zucca stufata con le verdure dell'orto,: Squash stewed with garden vegetables, blended and finished with rice cooked in it.
Zucchine a dadini soffritte piano mezz'o: Diced courgettes fried slowly for half an hour with oil, butter, salt and pepper.
Zucchine a rondelle cotte in casseruola: Courgette rounds cooked in a casserole with oil and garlic and finished with parsley.
Zucchine a rondelle infarinate e fritte,: Courgette rounds floured and fried, then bound in an omelette.
Zucchine al soffritto passate, legate co: Courgettes in soffritto, sieved, bound with béchamel, eggs and parmesan.
Zucchine crude a rondelle sottili marina: Raw courgettes in thin rounds marinated with spring onion, parsley, lemon juice, oil and pepper.
Zucchine lessate e scavate, riempite con: Boiled courgettes, hollowed out and filled with their flesh mixed with ricotta and basil, browned with montasio.
Zucchine rosolate nel burro, coperte di: Courgettes browned in butter, covered with béchamel and browned in the oven.
Zucchine stufate con olio, aceto, aglio: Courgettes stewed with oil, vinegar, garlic and oregano, finished with melted anchovies.
Zucchine svuotate e farcite di tonno, uo: Hollowed courgettes filled with tuna, eggs and parmesan, cooked in butter and tomato.
Zucchine tagliate per il lungo e gratina: Courgettes cut lengthways and browned in the oven with breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and a drizzle of oil.
Zucchine tagliate sottilissime e condite: Very thinly sliced courgettes dressed raw with lemon, oil, mint and a little grana.
Zuppa al forno a strati di pane nero, ve: A baked soup of layered rye bread, Savoy cabbage, Fontina and broth, with butter and cinnamon. It is baked until browned on top and served hot in bowls: it is the dish of the Valpelline.
Zuppa d'autunno con ceci, cannellini, pi: An autumn soup of chickpeas, cannellini beans, dried peas and barley, to which chestnuts are added halfway through cooking; it is served on toasted bread.
Zuppa densa di farro IGP e fagioli borlo: A thick soup of IGP spelt and puréed borlotti beans, with soffritto and tomato. It is eaten hot, with a drizzle of new oil: it is the spelt dish of the Garfagnana.
Zuppa densa di orzo, rape bianche, porri: A thick soup of barley, white turnips, leeks and carrot, bound with a little wholemeal flour and coloured with saffron.
Zuppa di cavolo nero, fagioli e pane raf: A soup of cavolo nero, beans and stale bread, better the next day, 'reboiled'. So thick that it stands up on the spoon: it is served with new oil and thinly sliced raw onion.
Zuppa di cipolle, sedano, pomodoro ed er: A soup of onions, celery, tomato and greens, with a poached egg on stale bread. A humble country soup, eaten hot in bowls, with the egg breaking over the bread.
Zuppa di fave fresche, pasta corta, pane: A soup of fresh broad beans, short pasta, toasted rye bread and Fontina, browned in the oven. Stringy and full of flavour: it is served hot, in bowls.
Zuppa di legumi e cereali misti, eredità: A soup of mixed pulses and grains, the legacy of ancient farming festivals. Thick and nourishing, it is eaten hot with raw oil.
Zuppa di legumi e grano di inizio agosto: A soup of pulses and wheat from early August, shared in the districts of the Sassi. Thick and nourishing, it is eaten hot with raw oil.
Zuppa di lenticchie con champignon, soff: Lentil soup with button mushrooms, soffritto, a little tomato and bay leaf.
Zuppa di lenticchie di Pietraroja con le: Pietraroja lentil soup with pork rinds, the dish of important lunches.
Zuppa di orzo perlato con champignon, po: Pearl barley soup with button mushrooms, dried porcini and borlotti beans, scented with rosemary.
Zuppa di pane raffermo cotto nell'acqua: A soup of stale bread cooked in water with fried onion and pancetta.
Zuppa di pesce cotta nel tegame di cocci: Fish soup cooked in the earthenware pan with sweet pepper and tomato. It is served in the pan, with toasted bread for the sauce.
Zuppa di pesce di scoglio e «pesce dimen: A soup of rock fish and «forgotten fish» in tomato, on garlic bread.
Zuppa di pesce e crostacei dei pescatori: A fishermen's soup of fish and shellfish, lightly red with tomato, on Tuscan bread.
Zuppa di pesce in bianco, senza pomodoro: A fish soup «in bianco», without tomato, with pepper and vinegar. A clean taste of the sea, a little sharp with vinegar: it is served hot, with bread.
Zuppa di pesce povero dell'Adriatico nat: A soup of humble Adriatic fish born on the fishing boats: a tomato and vinegar sauce in which mixed fish cook, to be eaten with bread.
Zuppa di zucchette con pomodori e pancet: A soup of small courgettes with tomatoes and pancetta, cooked in their own water.
Zuppa povera di ceci, fagioli e farro, c: A humble soup of chickpeas, beans and spelt, with raw oil and pepper. It is served hot, with a drizzle of new oil: it is the poor dish of La Spezia.
Zuppa rustica di pasta fatta in casa a s: A rustic soup of home-made pasta in strips with borlotti beans and tomato. Thick and hot, it is eaten in bowls, with raw oil.
«Collane» di piccole ciambelle di farina: «Necklaces» of small rings of flour, butter, sugar and milk, De.Co. (municipal designation of origin) of Rottofreno: once the godparents' gift to children being confirmed.
Agnello marinato in acqua e aceto, impan: Lamb marinated in water and vinegar, coated in breadcrumbs, parsley, garlic, oil and lemon and baked slowly in the oven: the recipe of Cameli, a hamlet of Sant'Elena Sannita.
Anelli di pasta lievitata molto morbida: Rings of very soft yeast dough fried in oil and served plain, with sugar or with honey, from the Immaculate Conception (8 December) to Epiphany.
Baccalà dissalato coperto di patate a fe: Desalted salt cod covered with sliced potatoes dressed with oil, salt and oregano and baked slowly in the oven.
Baccalà e mezze cipolle cotti in teglia: Salt cod and halved onions cooked in a tin under the ash and embers of the fireplace, covered with a larger tin: the “sotto la coppa” cooking of Sant'Elena Sannita.
Broccoli appena scottati e finiti di cuo: Broccoli just blanched and finished in oil with garlic and salted anchovies, in their own juices: the first course of Cavalcanti's Neapolitan Christmas Eve.
Broccoli scuri sbollentati e gratinati c: Dark broccoli, blanched and topped with breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano, chilli, cheese and raisins, cooked in a covered pan with embers above and below: the Christmas Eve side dish of Fagnano Castello.
Calamaretti e seppioline cotti in un fon: Baby squid and baby cuttlefish cooked on a base of onion, parsley, pine nuts, capers, raisins and black olives: the “cassuola” of the Neapolitan Christmas Eve.
Cappelletti di sfoglia all'uovo ripieni: Egg-pasta cappelletti filled with cooked and minced pork loin and chicken breast, mortadella, stracchino and Parmigiano, cooked in capon broth.
Carote cotte intere sotto la cenere cald: Carrots cooked whole under hot ash (or in the oven), sliced and dressed with salt, pepper and lemon juice: a very simple side dish of 18th-century Naples.
Cespi di lattuga lessati e conditi con u: Heads of lettuce boiled and dressed with a sauce of tarragon pounded with anchovies and capers, loosened with oil and vinegar: Corrado's way to “render la lattuga gustosa” (make lettuce tasty).
Crostata di quaresima con un guscio di f: A Lenten tart with a shell of flour, oil and white wine, filled with pounded almonds cooked in sugar with chocolate, cinnamon and candied pumpkin: Cavalcanti's Holy Tuesday dessert, with neither butter nor eggs.
Cuori di sedano scottati, cotti piano ne: Celery hearts blanched, cooked gently in butter with herbs and then baked au gratin with Parmigiano: a light side dish from the “Cuoco galante”.
Dolcetti di Natale a mezzaluna, di sfogl: Half-moon Christmas pastries of egg and lard pastry filled with Montepulciano grape jam, toasted almonds and orange zest.
